jobs.title: Cloud Software Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description: **Cloud Software Engineer (Azure)** **About the role** As a Cloud Software Engineer, you will make an impact by architecting and building cloud\-native, API\-driven solutions on Microsoft Azure that move, transform, and orchestrate data securely across enterprise systems. You will be a valued member of the engineering team and work collaboratively with product owners, architects, and cross\-functional Agile delivery teams. *\*Please note that this position is not eligible for visa transfer or sponsorship now or at any time in the future\** *\*\*Please note: A few of our roles may require in\-person interviews at Cognizant offices or client locations, depending on project or client needs. \*\** **In this role, you will** * Architect and develop solutions on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, and related services for data movement, transformation, and orchestration between systems. * Own the full API lifecycle using Azure API Management, including API design (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger), development, versioning, security, analytics, monitoring, and deprecation. * Implement API security, including authentication and authorization with Azure Active Directory, and develop and manage custom API security policies, mTLS, and API throttling. * Develop APIs using GraphQL as well as Java, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Boot. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Git and GitHub Actions while working within Agile/Scrum teams. **Work model** At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. **What you need to have to be considered** * Hands\-on experience architecting and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure using Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, and related services. * Strong API lifecycle management experience with Azure API Management, including API design (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger), versioning, security, analytics, monitoring, and deprecation. * Proven API security experience implementing authentication/authorization with Azure Active Directory, plus custom API security policies, mTLS, and API throttling. * Proficiency in Java, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Boot for API development, along with GraphQL API development. * Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (MySQL/Oracle/MongoDB), PL/SQL, CI/CD tooling (Git, GitHub Actions), and working in Agile/Scrum teams. **These will help you stand out** * Working knowledge of Angular, JavaScript, or C\+\+ to explore and understand existing applications. * Experience designing scalable, high\-performance data integration patterns across distributed systems. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. **Salary and Other Compensation** Applications will be accepted until October 9, 2026 * The annual salary for this position is between $69,000 \- $114,000 depending on the experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. * This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans. **Benefits** * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance * Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off * 401(k) plan and contributions * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.description: Color is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high\-quality, physician\-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline\-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at\-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology\-driven, patient\-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys. **The Team:** The **AI Platform Team** explores how rapidly evolving AI capabilities can create meaningful impact for patients, clinicians, and Color teams. We are a small, highly collaborative, cross\-functional team of engineers, product managers, designers, and clinical partners. We build AI applications, experiment with emerging models, tools, techniques and interaction patterns, and turn what works into durable patterns and capabilities that can be used across Color. We embrace rapid experimentation, learning quickly from new technologies and real\-world use, and bringing the most promising ideas into production. Given the pace at which AI is advancing, our goal is not simply to adopt the latest AI technology, but to identify where it creates meaningful value in cancer care and deliver AI experiences that are safe, reliable, and impactful. **The Role:** We’re hiring a **full\-stack Senior Software Engineer** to build AI products and the platform that powers them across Color. This new role will report to the Senior Director of AI Platform and work across the stack \- from intuitive clinician and patient\-facing AI experiences to the backend services and infrastructure that power them. This is a full\-stack role and we’re looking for candidates with senior level experience across frontend, backend and systems engineering. We seek a hands\-on builder with strong product instincts and deep curiosity about AI. You should be someone who experiments constantly, follows advancements in models and tooling, and translates emerging capabilities into reliable products. You will also raise Color’s AI fluency by sharing insights and demonstrating effective building patterns. **How You’ll Contribute:** * Build full\-stack AI applications for Color’s care teams and patients, owning features from user experience through backend services, AI orchestration, data access, and production deployment. * Explore where emerging AI capabilities can meaningfully improve cancer care and how Color works, moving rapidly from ideas to prototypes to shipped experiences. * Experiment rapidly with emerging AI capabilities, turning promising models, tools, and techniques into prototypes and incrementally evolving the best ideas into production systems. * Develop reliable LLM\-powered systems, including retrieval and knowledge systems, citations and grounding, prompt management, structured outputs, tool use, agentic workflows, and evaluation. * Develop the evaluation, observability, and safety practices needed to understand AI quality, compare approaches, identify regressions, and confidently evolve successful experiments into durable products. * Design privacy\- and security\-conscious systems appropriate for sensitive healthcare data and clinical workflows. * Partner closely with product, design, clinical, and engineering teams to understand problems, prototype solutions, learn from users, and ship improvements quickly. * Raise Color’s AI fluency by sharing experiments, emerging techniques, lessons learned, and strong patterns for building with AI across the company. * Mentor others and raise the technical and product quality bar. **Possible Projects To Contribute To:** * **Healthbook:** Build and evolve an internal AI application that helps our care and clinical teams understand patients’ longitudinal health histories, synthesize records, answer grounded questions with citations, and draft documents using an AI agent. * **AI Platform:** Build shared capabilities that enable teams across Color to develop reliable AI applications quickly, including knowledge bases and retrieval, citations and grounding, prompt management, evaluation, observability, and reusable agentic patterns. * **What’s next:** Explore the next generation of patient\-facing AI experiences, and turn what we learn into platform capabilities that enable teams across Color to build with AI. **Our Ideal Candidate Will Have**: * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production software, with strong full\-stack skills across React/TypeScript, Python, APIs, data integrations, and cloud infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience building production AI products with modern LLMs, including patterns such as RAG, structured outputs, tool calling, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. * Experience turning complex, heterogeneous data into useful product experiences and taking systems from prototype through production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration. * Strong product judgment and the ability to balance speed, technical quality, reliability, and user impact in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments. * A bias toward tinkering, rapid experimentation, and learning. You start small, prototype quickly, measure what works, and recognize when new AI capabilities create opportunities for a larger leap. * An informed point of view on how AI is changing software engineering and product development. You regularly experiment with new models, frameworks, coding tools, agent architectures, and interaction patterns—and communicate what you learn. You are someone others at Color look to for what’s new in AI, what works in practice, and how we should apply it. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI platforms or shared infrastructure that empowered multiple teams to ship AI applications. * Experience developing healthcare technology involving sensitive clinical data. *We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.* **What We Offer:** * Competitive salary * ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits * 401k match * Monthly phone and wifi stipend for employees, annual ergonomic stipend * Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company\-wide recharge days * Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free cancer screening and prevention resources for employees and their adult dependents **Base Salary Range:** $175,000 \- $230,000 *The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: work experience, market data, skills, geographic location, and business need. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity and benefits.* Color prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Color conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities in our recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Financial Data, Reporting & Analytics
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager for the team that owns the financial core of our revenue cycle product. That's three things: the ledger that records every financial event, the reports that billing managers and CFOs close their books on, and the analytics that tell a practice how it's doing. You'll manage 6 to 8 engineers, from early\-career to Senior Staff, own the roadmap with your product partner, and be accountable for financial correctness across the platform. We're partway through rebuilding this surface: moving a decade of report logic onto a drift\-free ledger and a modern OLAP layer, while customers keep closing their books on the old one. **What You'll Do** * Manage and grow a team of 6 to 8 engineers. Hiring, performance, career growth. Build people who can each run a customer escalation, a data migration, or an incident end\-to\-end without you in the room. * Set the roadmap with your product partner. The goal is to get from building whatever report a customer asked for to customers building their own reports and closing their books without us involved. * Own financial correctness. For this team, wrong numbers are a worse failure than a slow page. You'll own the systems that catch silent errors: shadow parity harnesses, cross\-report tie\-out checks, drift monitoring, and correctness SLOs next to the uptime ones. * Lead multi\-quarter migrations (ledger report migration, OLAP golden views) incrementally, with parity checks at each step, without breaking anyone's close. * Own the customer relationship at the top of the stack. Sit with comptrollers, CFOs, and RCM directors at our largest sites during month\-end. Turn their definition of "correct" into software, and turn recurring escalations into roadmap. * Run cross\-team execution with the payments/posting team, data infrastructure, and ops so upstream changes don't quietly break downstream numbers. **What You Have** * 5\+ years managing software engineers, including senior and staff\-level ICs. You've grown engineers into leads and staff engineers, and you can name them. * You've shipped financial, reporting, or data\-intensive systems in production where the numbers had to tie. jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description: Overview: Complete Building Services (CBS) is a company that is passionate about the operation and maintenance of buildings/facilities in the commercial and government sectors. CBS is the largest division of The Donohoe Companies, Inc. \- Washington DC's most established real estate company. At CBS, we celebrate and empower our talented employees \- and it shows as we have been ranked by the Washington Business Journal as the Best Place to Work multiple times. Perks \& Benefits We offer a full slate of benefits, including competitive salaries, medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverages, FSA, flexible vacation, commuter benefits, and a 401k plan with a match. And...we offer some not\-so\-standard, extra great benefits, including tuition reimbursement for education/certifications, employee discounts programs (including hotels and our vendor's products), and an Employee Assistance Program that offers free financial consultants, therapists, and lawyers. We value diversity and believe in forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is the key to our success. Come join us, and find out what the best work of your career could look like for you. Responsibilities: Complete Building Services is looking for an Assistant Project Manager (APM) in Martinsburg, WV. The APM shall provide assistance and daily coordination for building\-related infrastructure and tenant alteration projects, as well as regularly interface both verbally and in writing with Tenants, Tenant Representatives, Property Management, Engineering Staff, construction professionals, and other vendors. Must be flexible with time and schedule as needed. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Obtain cost estimates and prepare quotes for TWO’s and IRO’s * Assign projects to subcontractors or design professional consultants and subcontractors, as needed, as determined by the Government * Coordinate and schedule projects, including pricing, estimating costs, and processing BSR, TWO, or IRO * Administer BSR, TWO, and IRO including issuing Contractor purchase orders for subcontractors or design professional consultants and subcontractors as required * Provide technical review of projects in advance of submission for AOC Technical Review, to ensure compliance with AOC Standards and to ensure that work fully meets tenant requirements * Provide oversight and supervision of all Contractor staff to ensure on\-time completion of PM’s, BSR’s, TWO’s, and IRO’s * Provide on\-time Deliverables, to the COR * Ensure timely invoice submission of TWO and IRO work efforts * Maintain and administer the CMMS * Conduct Facility Management Services Quality Control, and inspections and thence coordinate CM repairs as required * Maintain professional and effective relationships with the tenants, COR, AOC employees, Security Manager, and Contractor employees * Daily, communicate and coordinate with the on\-site Security Manager employed by the Security Contractor * Ensure all Contractor and subcontractor employees supporting this contract have received the necessary and required training * Ensure all Contractor and subcontractor employees supporting this contract have received necessary Government background checks and badging before reporting on\-site * Ensure all Contractor and subcontractor employees supporting this contract have read and understand the Building Rules and Regulations Salary: $80,000 to $104,000 Hours: 7:00 am to 3:30 pm M\-F ***\*Contingent upon contract award\**** Qualifications: **The Assistant Project Manager shall possess the following minimum qualifications:*** Not less than three (3\) years of previous experience within the last five (5\) years serving in the role of Assistant Project Manager, or Project Manager, at a facility of comparable size, comparable function, with similar infrastructure including (1\) chilled water and steam systems; (2\) UPS Systems; (3\) security surveillance systems; (4\) security physical barrier systems; (5\) fire alarm and fire suppression life safety systems; (6\) generator systems; and (7\) building automated controls systems. Demonstrated experience providing facility management and operation and maintenance management is required. Previous experience managing federal or state office buildings is desirable * Completion of post\-secondary school training in facilities management and supervision, at minimum possess an associate degree in a field related to facility management and operation and maintenance * Demonstrated ability to plan, organize and meet project deadlines * Demonstrated ability to work on several projects simultaneously and prioritize work as required * Demonstrated working technical expertise in engineering and building infrastructure systems * Ability to read and understand blueprints * Proficiency with word processing, spreadsheet, and project tracking software * The Project Manager shall be available for emergency contact via cell phone twenty\-four (24\) hours a day, seven (7\) days a week * The Project Manager shall have availability to work flexible hours as required in response to emergencies * Demonstrated ability to provide error\-free written correspondence (e.g. progress and status reports, notifications, memoranda, executive summaries) in an on\-time manner * Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with a positive and cooperative attitude, orally and in writing, to all audiences; prepare and conduct briefings; make public announcements; coordinate and facilitate meetings * Demonstrated ability and experience managing and coordinating emergency events involving a multitude of parties including tenants, law enforcement and other officials, and several agencies and organizations * Previous experience as Chief Engineer is desirable, but not a requirement * Demonstrated experience managing building reconstitution efforts after building closure due to damage or an emergency event *EOE, including disability/veterans*

and enhance REST APIs that support internal and customer\-facing products * Develop intuitive user interfaces using Angular and modern web technologies * Create scalable backend solutions using .NET, C\#, and SQL Server * Support modernization initiatives, technical debt reduction, and application upgrades * Develop automation solutions that improve efficiency for operational and conversion teams * Participate in code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and production support activities * Collaborate with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions * Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-based initiatives as the organization continues its technology evolution * Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior team jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description: **About Us:** Consertus is an AI\-native global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep industry expertise with advanced digital capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,400 professionals, we help clients plan, deliver, and optimize complex capital programs across the full project lifecycle. Our integrated capabilities span advisory, digital solutions, engineering and design, and program delivery, enabling organizations to navigate complexity, mitigate risk, and achieve strategic objectives. We serve a diverse range of industries, including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial real estate, life sciences, and technology. At Consertus, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative, flexible, and inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop their skills, and make a meaningful impact. Together, we're transforming the way the world is planned, built, and delivered. Learn more about how Consertus is creating lasting value for clients, communities, and our people at www.consertus.com . **About this Role:** The Project Coordinator supports construction projects by managing documentation, coordinating field activities, and ensuring project tasks are executed according to schedule and specifications. This role requires strong writing abilities, technical understanding of civil engineering concepts, and consistent on‑site presence to monitor progress and support project teams. Must speak fluent English. **Candidate must be an EIT.** **Key Responsibilities:** * Coordinate daily project activities and maintain accurate project documentation. * Prepare reports, meeting minutes, and written communications with high clarity and professionalism. * Review drawings, specifications, and technical documents to support project execution. * Conduct regular site visits to monitor work progress and ensure compliance with project requirements. * Support project managers with scheduling, tracking deliverables, and resolving field issues. * Communicate effectively with contractors, engineers, and internal stakeholders. jobs.title: Sr. Product Reliability Engineer - MV Transformers
jobs.description: If you like being the person who makes a good design even better once it’s out in the field — chasing a field failure until you know exactly why it happened, tightening a tolerance that’s been costing installers time, or turning a one\-off fix into a documented standard — this role is worth your full attention. CORE Transformers manufactures dry\-type, pad mount, and substation transformers from 15 kVA to 30 MVA, up to 230 kV. We supply critical electrical infrastructure to AI\-driven data centers, large\-scale construction, and industrial operations nationwide. We’re tracking 3x annual revenue growth, which means more units in the field, more installers depending on our designs working the first time, and a real need for someone who owns the gap between a good design on paper and a good design in the field. **Your Mission** You are joining as our first dedicated **Sr. Product Reliability Engineer \- MV Transformers**. Where our R\&D team builds tomorrow’s product line, you own what’s already shipped and what’s in production today: field performance, installation issues, quality escapes, and the steady stream of engineering changes that keep our standard designs current and our manufacturing partners aligned to spec. You’ll work closely with our quality team, our overseas manufacturing partners, and our sales organization to close the loop between what customers experience in the field and what actually gets built. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering, with this role positioned to grow — and to grow a team — as CORE scales. **A Day in the Life** Your morning starts with a field report: a pad mount unit installed on a data\-center campus tripped during commissioning. You pull the test records, talk through the symptoms with the customer’s electrical contractor, and narrow it down to a CT wiring convention that’s easy to get backwards in the field. You open a corrective action, and before lunch you’ve drafted a one\-page field bulletin and flagged the accessory drawing for an update. In the afternoon you join a call with our quality team and our overseas manufacturing partner to review last month’s incoming inspection data. Two recurring nonconformances trace back to a tolerance that’s tighter on paper than it needs to be in practice — you work through the fix and issue the engineering change. Sales calls with a question from a contractor about an installation detail on a unit shipped last quarter; you walk them through it directly. You close the day updating the standard design library: the CT wiring fix gets folded into the master drawing, the installation guide gets a clarifying diagram, and the change gets logged so R\&D can see the pattern if it shows up again. Every day looks a little different. What stays constant is that your work shows up in transformers already in the field. **Who You Are** You are hands on and detail oriented, and you get real satisfaction from closing the loop between a field issue and a permanent fix. You have working knowledge of both inside\-the\-tank transformer fundamentals and outside\-the\-tank systems — switchgear integration, protection devices, CT configurations — and you’re comfortable being the technical point of contact when a customer’s engineer or an installer has a question. You’re organized enough to run a disciplined change and documentation process, and you don’t mind being the person who has to say “this needs to change” to a design that already shipped. You’re looking to build a sustaining/quality engineering function almost from scratch, not to inherit one that’s already fully staffed. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Serve as the primary engineering owner for field issues, warranty claims, and quality escapes on units already in production — root cause investigation, corrective action, and closure. * Manage the engineering change process for existing standard designs: evaluate requests from quality, manufacturing, and the field, and issue updated drawings and specifications. * Partner with our quality team and overseas manufacturing partners to translate real field experience into tighter incoming inspection, in\-process, and outgoing test criteria. * Provide installation and field support for sales, contractors, and customers, including on\-site troubleshooting when needed. * Maintain and improve technical documentation for standard designs: drawings, spec sheets, installation guides, and accessory configurations. * Manage product and company certifications with oversight agencies to maintain customer confidence in delivered products. * Track field\-defect trends and report them back to Quality so recurring issues get designed out of future standard designs, not just patched in the field. * Support third\-party testing and validation follow\-up whenever a field issue calls a result into question. * Help build out CORE’s quality\-support function as the team grows — today this is one person; it will not stay that way. **What You’ll Need to Succeed** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience in medium\-voltage transformer or power systems engineering. * 5\+ years of engineering experience in power systems, medium\-voltage electrical equipment, or transformer manufacturing, with real exposure to what happens after a unit ships. * Working knowledge of liquid\-filled and/or dry\-type transformer design fundamentals: core and coil, winding configurations, insulation systems. * Comfort with outside\-the\-tank systems: switchgear integration points, protection devices, CT configurations, and accessory hardware. * Experience with root\-cause analysis and corrective\-action processes (8D, 5\-Why, or similar) in a manufacturing environment. * Ability to read and markup engineering drawings, and to write clear, field\-usable documentation. * Willingness to travel occasionally for on\-site installation or field support. * Willing and able to work on\-site in Seneca, SC. **Bonus Points If You Have...** * Experience coordinating quality or engineering specs with an overseas manufacturing partner. * Experience in data center, hyperscale, or large\-scale construction power systems. * Familiarity with UL, IEEE, IEC, or NEC standards relevant to transformers. * A quality\-engineering background (CQE or equivalent experience). * Experience at a fast\-growing or PE\-backed manufacturer where the org is still being built. *CORE Transformers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Integrations Engineer
jobs.description: Thank you for your interest in a career with County of Galveston. Please click on the Apply button if interested in this job. **General Description** The purpose of this class is to design, implement, maintain, and support enterprise application integrations, interfaces, APIs, and automated data exchanges that enable secure and reliable interoperability among County technology systems. The position serves as a senior technical resource for enterprise integration and is responsible for integration solutions supporting financial and human resources systems, Courts, Public Safety, general administrative systems, and other County applications. The position independently analyzes complex integration requirements and designs effective, secure, reliable, and supportable solutions using enterprise integration platforms, APIs, database technologies, and other data exchange methods. **Duties and Responsibilities** **The functions listed below are those that represent the majority of the time spent working in this class. Management may assign additional functions related to the type of work of the class as necessary.** * Designs, develops, implements, maintains, and supports enterprise application integrations, interfaces, APIs, and automated data exchanges among County and third\-party systems. * Develops and supports integration solutions for financial and human resources systems, Courts, Public Safety, general administrative systems, and other enterprise and departmental applications. * Designs and implements secure, reliable, maintainable, and fault\-tolerant integrations using enterprise integration platforms, APIs, web services, database technologies, file\-based exchanges, and other appropriate integration methods. * Develops, configures, administers, monitors, and troubleshoots integrations using the County's enterprise integration platform and related technologies. * Designs, implements, and supports REST and SOAP APIs, web services, and other system interfaces and works with data formats and technologies including JSON, XML, CSV, SQL, and comparable technologies. * Investigates and resolves complex integration failures and data exchange issues; analyzes logs, system behavior, data, interfaces, and dependencies to identify root causes and implement corrective solutions. * Implements and maintains monitoring, logging, error handling, alerting, recovery, and data validation processes to ensure integration reliability, data integrity, and operational supportability. * Works with application owners, business analysts, vendors, and other Information Technology staff to analyze integration requirements, data flows, system dependencies, and technical specifications and translate requirements into effective integration solutions. * Supports application implementations, upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives requiring new or modified integrations, interfaces, APIs, or data exchanges. * Develops and maintains integration mappings, technical specifications, data flow documentation, interface inventories, support procedures, and other technical documentation necessary to support the County's integration environment. * Ensures integration solutions are implemented and maintained in accordance with established cybersecurity, access control, change management, testing, documentation, and technology governance requirements. * Provides technical expertise and knowledge transfer to Applications staff and collaborates with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Network, project management, vendors, and other Enterprise Services functions to support enterprise systems and resolve complex technical issues. Performs related work as assigned. * **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements:** * Requires a Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, information systems, or a closely related field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. * Requires five years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise systems integration, application integration, middleware, API development and support, enterprise applications, or closely related information technology work. * Requires experience in several of the following areas: \-Enterprise integration platforms or integration\-platform\-as\-a\-service (iPaaS) technologies. * REST and SOAP APIs, web services, and system interfaces. * JSON, XML, CSV, and other structured data formats. * SQL and relational database technologies. * Application\-to\-application and system\-to\-system data exchange. * File\-based integrations, secure file transfer, or scheduled data exchanges. * Integration monitoring, logging, error handling, troubleshooting, and recovery * Authentication, authorization, encryption, certificates, or other security concepts associated with system integrations. * Enterprise application implementations, upgrades, migrations, or modernization initiatives. * Technical requirements, integration specifications, data mapping, and technical documentation. * Experience with Boomi is preferred. * Experience integrating enterprise financial, human resources, payroll, procurement, Courts, Public Safety, or other government systems is preferred. Requires strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills. * **Physical Demands/Work Environment** *Physical demands refer to the requirements for physical exertion and coordination of limb and body movement.* Unavoidable hazards refer to the job conditions that may lead to injury or health hazards even though precautions have been taken. The work is primarily performed in an office environment and requires prolonged periods of sitting and use of computers and other standard office equipment. The employee may occasionally stand, walk, bend, stoop, reach, and lift or move equipment or materials weighing up to 25 pounds. The position may require travel between County facilities and work outside of normal business hours to support system implementations, maintenance activities, system outages, or other operational needs. jobs.description: **Job Title: Special Inspector** **Job Summary** The Special Inspector is responsible for conducting on\-site inspections of construction projects to ensure compliance with building codes, specifications, and safety regulations. This role plays a critical part in maintaining quality and ensuring that materials and workmanship meet required standards. **Key Responsibilities** **On\-Site Inspections*** Perform regular inspections and testing of construction work, including soils, aggregates, asphalt, concrete, steel, masonry, and other materials, to ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable codes. * Document inspection findings and communicate any deficiencies or non\-compliance issues to the project manager or contractor. **Testing and Sampling*** Conduct field testing of construction materials (e.g., soil, concrete, asphalt) and collect samples for laboratory analysis. * Ensure proper testing procedures are followed and that equipment is calibrated and maintained. **Documentation and Reporting*** Prepare detailed inspection reports, including observations, test results, and any corrective actions taken or needed. * Maintain accurate and organized records of inspections, tests, and communications related to the project. **Collaboration and Communication*** Work closely with contractors, project managers, engineers, and architects to ensure project specifications are complies with local, state, and federal building codes, as well as industry standards (e.g., ASTM, AASHTO). * Participate in quality assurance programs and assist in the development of quality control plans. **Safety Oversight*** Promote and follow safety practices on construction sites, ensuring compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations. * Report any safety violations or hazardous conditions immediately. **Continual Learning and Development*** Stay updated on current construction practices, codes, and regulations through ongoing education and professional development. * Attend training sessions and workshops to enhance technical skills and knowledge. **Qualifications*** **Education**: High School Diploma * **Experience**: Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in construction inspection or materials testing. * **Certifications**: Certification as a Special Inspector (e.g., ICC Special Inspector, NICET, ACI, AWS, Caltrans) is highly jobs.title: Engineer I, Downstream Processing
jobs.description: **Position At A Glance** **Location:** Boulder, CO \- On\-Site **Employment:** Full\-Time DMC Employee **Compensation:** $78,000\-$95,000 annually, based on experience and position level **Benefits:** Full DMC Employee Benefits **Duration:** 12\-Month Project Position **Anticipated Start:** October 2026**About DMC Biotechnologies** ============================= DMC is a biotechnology company based in Boulder, CO, and RTP, NC. Our Dynamic Metabolic Control™ technology platform delivers robust and predictably scalable biocatalysts resulting in cost\-competitive and sustainable processes for everyday chemicals. We are a multi\-product bio\-based chemical company, working ingeniously to reduce the cost of biochemicals for markets in animal feed, human nutrition, pharmaceutical materials, and chemical intermediates. **The Role** ============ We are looking for an Engineer I to join our Downstream Processing team in Boulder, Colorado. This hands\-on, laboratory\-based role will support the development and scale\-up of processes used to recover and purify products from fermentation. Engineer I will work under the guidance of experienced engineers and scientists while collaborating across the broader technical team. Responsibilities will include planning and executing experiments, operating bench\-scale processing equipment, analyzing data, documenting results, and contributing to the transfer of successful processes to pilot and commercial scale. Please note that this position is supported by grant funding and is initially offered for a 12\-month term, subject to the terms and duration of the grant. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Support development and optimization of processes for the purification of compounds of interest from fermentation * Plan and execute laboratory experiments involving unit operations with guidance, such as microfiltration/ultrafiltration, evaporation/distillation, preparative\-scale chromatography, crystallization, and reaction chemistry * Use analytical chemistry techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, GC, titrations, and spectrophotometry to quantify compounds of interest in complex mixtures * Analyze experimental data, draw data\-driven conclusions, and communicate results to the broader technical team * Maintain clear and accurate experimental records, calculations, and technical summaries * Effectively track important experimental parameters and data, with a focus on mass balances, product yield and product quality (purity). * Support process modeling, including technoeconomic modeling of anticipated and/or established processes and performance metrics at commercial scale * Prepare reagents and materials including media, buffers, and stock solutions * Coordinate experimental schedules within a broader team * Troubleshoot and improve experimental methods and downstream processes * Maintain safe laboratory practices and contribute to a safe, clean, and organized work environment **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or related discipline * Hands\-on experience with unit operations such as membrane filtration, evaporation, distillation, crystallization, chromatography, reaction chemistry, and solid\-liquid separation * Ability to safely operate laboratory equipment and execute written experimental procedures * Ability to analyze quantitative data, clearly document results, and draw data\-driven conclusions * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple experiments or priorities * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional team **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Relevant industry or internship experience * Experience with HPLC, UPLC, GC, titrations, spectrophotometry, or other analytical methods * Experience with process modeling, cost\-of\-goods analysis, and technoeconomic analysis * Programming experience using Python or similar tools for automation, engineering calculations, and data analysis * Experience developing Arduino or Raspberry Pi based systems * Experience working with fermentation\-derived products or complex biological mixtures **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** ====================================================== We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working\-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ\+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups. Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior\-level positions. With that in mind, we encourage you to apply if you're not sure whether you meet our qualifications. We'd love to have the opportunity to consider you.

jobs.title: ETL Developer / HPCC Data Engineer
jobs.description: ##### **Role Summary** DataSeers is looking for experienced ETL Developers / Data Engineers with HPCC Systems and ECL experience to build and maintain large\-scale financial data pipelines. A significant portion of DataSeers' data ingestion, normalization, transformation, linking, enrichment, and analytical processing is performed using HPCC Systems and Enterprise Control Language (ECL). This is not a traditional SQL\-only ETL position. You will work with large and complex financial datasets and develop ECL\-based data workflows that transform disparate source data into standardized, reliable datasets used across DataSeers products. You will work with data from banks, credit unions, fintechs, payment processors, core banking systems, and other financial platforms. ##### **What You Will Do** * Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL workflows using **HPCC Systems and ECL**. * Build ECL datasets, records, transforms, joins, rollups, deduplication processes, and data validation logic. * Ingest structured and semi\-structured financial data from multiple sources. * Develop data mappings from client source formats into DataSeers canonical data structures. * Normalize inconsistent customer, account, business, signer, beneficial\-owner, transaction, and counterparty data. * Build complex entity\-linking and relationship logic. * Develop large\-scale joins and matching processes across financial datasets. * Troubleshoot incorrect joins, duplicate records, missing relationships, data\-shifting issues, malformed files, and inconsistent identifiers. * Build reusable ECL components and data\-processing patterns. * Optimize HPCC jobs for performance and scalability. * Analyze Thor and Roxie workloads where applicable. * Develop validation and reconciliation routines to ensure data completeness and accuracy. * Work with MySQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka, APIs, and other components of the DataSeers ecosystem. * Support both batch and near\-real\-time processing requirements. * Work closely with customer implementation teams to understand source data and integration requirements. * Investigate data\-quality issues before they propagate into compliance, fraud, reconciliation, or reporting systems. * Participate in code review, testing, deployment validation, and production troubleshooting. ##### **Required Experience** * 3\+ years of ETL, data engineering, or large\-scale data\-processing experience. * Hands\-on experience with **HPCC Systems**. * Strong experience developing in **ECL**. * Strong understanding of ECL concepts including datasets, records, transforms, joins, normalize, denormalize, rollups, deduplication, and distributed processing. * Strong SQL skills. * Strong understanding of data structures, relationships, and data modeling. * Experience troubleshooting complex joins and data relationships. * Experience working with large datasets. * Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, referential integrity, and exception handling. * Experience with Git or equivalent source control. * Strong analytical and debugging skills. ##### **Preferred Experience** * Banking, fintech, payments, or financial services experience. * Experience working with ACH, wires, cards, RTP, FedNow, checks, or other payment data. * HPCC Thor and Roxie experience. * Experience optimizing large ECL jobs. * Elasticsearch experience. * MySQL experience. * Kafka or event\-driven processing experience. * Experience with AML, fraud, KYC/KYB, or transaction monitoring. * Python, JavaScript, Node.js, or Java experience is useful, but secondary to HPCC/ECL expertise. ##### **What Success Looks Like** Within the first several months, you should be able to receive a new client dataset, understand its relationships, build or modify the necessary HPCC/ECL ingestion and transformation logic, identify data\-quality issues, correctly link related entities, and produce validated datasets for downstream DataSeers applications.

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer** -------------------------------------- **New York City · On\-site · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $180K–$250K base \+ competitive equity ### **About the Company** Our client is a well\-funded, seed\-stage AI company building the revenue execution platform for B2B enterprises. Their product pairs LLMs with structured customer data to tell post\-sales teams which accounts to prioritize, why, and what to do next, automating work that account management and customer success teams have long done by hand. They are already live with Fortune 500 customers and have meaningful contracted revenue. Founded 2025 · Small founding team · Industry: AI, B2B, Enterprise ### **The Role** As the first Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the technical deployment of the platform into enterprise customer environments. You will sit between messy customer data warehouses and production agent workflows, turning each customer's business knowledge into verified data models that drive measurable revenue outcomes. You will work directly with the founding team and report to the CTO. **What you'll be doing** * Leading new customer onboardings from start to finish: scoping data access, exploring undocumented warehouses, and mapping complex schemas to business concepts like churn, expansion, and ARR * Building and validating the semantic layer by working with customer stakeholders, reconciling conflicting definitions, and encoding them as verified SQL * Deploying workflows and agent pipelines into customer instances, then monitoring them to make sure they deliver results * Running 2–3 customer engagements at a time in shared channels with customer data and engineering teams (roughly a quarter of your time customer\-facing, the rest hands\-on data work) * Using the internal agent tooling daily and shaping how the team improves evals, validation, and the agent harness **Tech stack:** SQL, dbt, data warehousing, Python, LLMs, AI agents, signal engineering, eval frameworks ### **Requirements** * 2–5 years in a forward deployed, data science, or customer\-facing engineering role * A track record of personally leading technical customer deployments, including data access, schema mapping, stakeholder alignment, and demonstrating value * Experience building and shipping production data pipelines or systems on your own, from writing the code through debugging and deployment * Strong SQL and data warehouse skills, including working confidently in poorly documented or legacy schemas and producing output you have validated yourself * A daily AI\-first workflow: you use tools like Claude or Cursor and have built or tailored your own agent\-based workflows * Solid applied statistics sense, such as understanding distributions, seasonality, and validation design, and knowing when a result is noise * A background along one of these paths: forward deployed, customer, or solutions engineering at a leading data or AI company; analytics engineering or data science followed by customer\-facing delivery; or consulting, PE, or banking paired with a genuine CS and engineering foundation * The confidence to hold a technical position when customers push back, while staying open to changing your mind based on evidence * Comfort with detailed, repetitive data verification, which makes up most of the role * A bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, or another quantitative STEM field from a top\-tier university * Based in or willing to relocate to New York City and work in the office five days a week ### **Nice to Haves** * Experience at an early\-stage startup (seed through Series B); large tech company experience is most relevant when combined with startup or founder experience ### **Why Join** * Join as a founding engineer at a company that already has real enterprise traction and strong investor backing * Above\-market base salary plus meaningful equity, with flexibility for exceptional candidates * Own the most important technical path in the business, since every customer deployment runs through this role * Attack a large, underserved market in post\-sales execution with one of the first purpose\-built platforms * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, parental leave, a monthly wellness stipend, daily lunches, flexible vacation, and up to $10K in relocation support for out\-of\-state hires ### **Details** * **Location:** New York City, NY * **Work policy:** On\-site 5 days a week * **Compensation:** $180,000–$250,000 \+ equity * **Visa sponsorship:** Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H\-1B transfers) * **Employment type:** Full\-time

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist/Installation Engineer
jobs.description: Job description: **Technical Support Specialist / X\-Ray Installation Engineer** **Del Medical \| Bloomingdale, IL \| Full\-Time** **Launch Your Career in Medical Imaging Technology** Del Medical is a leading manufacturer of advanced medical imaging systems dedicated to improving patient care through innovative X\-ray technology. We are seeking an ambitious **Technical Support Specialist / X\-Ray Installation Engineer** to join our growing Technical Service team. This role is designed as a **career development opportunity** for a technically driven individual who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology, and building hands\-on engineering skills. The successful candidate will begin by developing expertise in Del Medical’s digital radiography and X\-ray systems through technical support, training, and equipment preparation. As skills and knowledge grow, this individual will transition into **installation, commissioning, and field service support** of medical imaging equipment throughout North America. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate, early\-career engineer, technician, or military\-trained technical professional looking to build a rewarding career in medical technology. **What You’ll Do** **Technical Support \& Training** * Learn and troubleshoot Del Medical X\-ray and digital imaging systems. * Provide technical support to customers, distributors, dealers, and Field Service Engineers. * Diagnose electrical, mechanical, software, and system\-related issues. * Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation. * Document troubleshooting activities and recommend corrective actions. * Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve products. **Installation \& Field Service Development** * Progress into installing, configuring, and commissioning X\-ray systems at healthcare facilities. * Perform mechanical assembly, electrical connections, system testing, and calibration. * Train customers on equipment operation and basic maintenance. * Travel throughout North America alongside experienced engineers. **Qualifications** **Preferred Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Robotics, Physics, Biomechanical Engineering or related technical field. * Associate degree candidates or individuals with relevant technical experience will also be considered. **Preferred Experience:** * Electronics troubleshooting * Mechanical assembly * Electrical systems * Technical support * Manufacturing equipment * Field service * Robotics or automation **Technical Skills:** * Ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams. * Familiarity with digital/analog electronics and electrical testing equipment. * Basic computer and networking knowledge. * Strong mechanical aptitude and problem\-solving skills. **The Ideal Candidate** We are looking for someone who is: * Curious and eager to learn. * Hands\-on and technically motivated. * A strong problem solver. * Customer\-focused and professional. * Comfortable working independently and as part of a team. * Interested in building a long\-term engineering career. **Career Growth Opportunities** This role provides a structured career path into: * Technical Support Specialist II * X\-Ray Installation Engineer * Field Service Engineer * Senior Field Service Engineer * Technical Trainer * Technical Service Manager **Why Join Del Medical?** At Del Medical, you will not just support equipment — you will help deliver technology that impacts patient care around the world. We offer: * Competitive salary * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) * LTD, STD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * Paid time off and holidays * Hands\-on technical training * Mentorship from experienced engineers * Career advancement opportunities * Collaborative team environment **Start your career with Del Medical and grow into a highly skilled medical technology professional.** Benefits: Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bloomingdale, IL 60108

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization. **Work you'll do** * Design and deploy Azure services, ensuring compliance with best practices for security, scalability, and availability. * Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates. * Configure Azure services such as Azure Virtual Machines, App Services, Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, Storage Accounts, etc. * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to provide visibility into application, infrastructure performance, security, reliability and cost. * Manage identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC). * Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and audits to identify and remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. * Automate routine tasks and workflows using Azure Automation and develop Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments. * Provide technical support for cloud\-based applications and infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve performance, scalability, and availability issues. This includes Windows and Linux VM support. * Hands\-on experience in integrating cloud platforms with other cloud\-based systems, ensuring data consistency and availability. * Participate in assessments and audits of existing Azure deployments to ensure compliance with organizational standards. * Ensure operational activities are completed within the required SLAs. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and support tailored Azure solutions. * Develop and maintain documentation, including technical guides and operational procedures. * Stay updated on emerging Azure services and technologies, integrating them where applicable. * Use DevOps practices, including Github for version control, to manage cloud. * Working knowledge of Azure AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Microsoft Foundry) and how they integrate with core Azure infrastructure (VNets, Private Endpoints, Key Vault, etc.) **The team** Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience * 3\+ years of experience working with Microsoft Azure, including architecture, configuration, and management. * Familiarity with Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Policy, AKS, Azure Databases, Azure Network etc * Strong experience with PowerShell Scripting. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) such as ARM templates, Terraform, or Bicep. * Relevant active Azure certifications, such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ \- 104\), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ \- 400\), are preferred. * Full stack development experience is an advantage. * Strong understanding of Agile methodologies. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization. **Work you'll do** Key Responsibilities * Own application deployment, release, configuration, and operational support across environments. * Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. * Deploy and manage containerized applications on Kubernetes. * Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Azure or AWS services. * Automate infrastructure and operational processes using scripting and Infrastructure as Code. * Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, and disaster\-recovery practices. * Troubleshoot build, deployment, infrastructure, and production issues. * Improve application availability, scalability, security, and performance. * Establish deployment standards, branching strategies, rollback procedures, and environment controls. * Collaborate with development, QA, security, and product teams. Participate in on\-call support and conduct root\-cause analysis for incidents. * **The team** Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived. **Qualifications** Required Qualifications * 6 years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or site reliability engineering. * Strong experience with**Azure or AWS**. * Practical experience administering and troubleshooting**Kubernetes**. * Hands\-on expertise with**Azure DevOps**, including Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts, and Boards. * Proficiency in at least one scripting language:**Bash, PowerShell, or Python**. * Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment. * Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep * Understanding of networking, security, identity and access management, and cloud cost optimization. * Experience with application monitoring and logging tools. Strong troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

jobs.title: Entry Level Water Resources Engineer
jobs.description: Dewberry is currently seeking an **Entry Level Water Resources Engineer** to perform water resource work in our **Gainesville, VA** office. Individual will develop concept and final design of stormwater facilities/treatment, perform floodplain studies, analyze stormwater quality, design stream restoration, dam design, dam retrofit, and perform dam break studies among other projects and tasks. *Dewberry is a leading, market\-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors is our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half\-century.* * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering with a focus in Water Resources or related field is required * Knowledge of floodplain delineation, storm water management, culvert and bridge hydraulics, and drainage design * 0 \- 1 year of experience; previous internship(s) preferred * Strong verbal and written communication skills are required * Proficiency in MS Office software * Ability to work in a team environment *Don’t meet every single requirement? At Dewberry we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for our employees. jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Welcome to our dynamic team, where we pioneer the development of processes and equipment for all iterations of Dexcom wearables and applicators. jobs.title: Senior Data Science Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.Discord is where the world's gamers hang out, and increasingly, it's the platform game developers build on. We're seeking a Senior Data Science Manager to lead Data Science for our Developer Platform: the SDKs, identity systems, and developer tools that connect games and their players to Discord. What makes this role distinctive is the two\-sided value equation at the heart of the platform. For game developers, we build tools that help studios grow player engagement and revenue, including data products that give them deeper insight into their players and communities. For players, we use signals from those same tools to make it easier to play and hang out with friends, deepen engagement across Discord, and deliver more relevant ads. Your team's job is to make both sides of that exchange demonstrably valuable. That means proving the platform's worth to developers with rigorous evidence, and ensuring the signals it generates create outsized, responsible value for Discord users. If helping make Discord an even better place to hang out with your friends and communities sounds like an exciting challenge \- we'd love to chat with you! What you'll be doing Manage, mentor, and develop a mission\-driven team of Data Scientists embedded across the Developer Platform's core areas: identity, signals, and developer tools. Own the vision and roadmap for data\-driven decision\-making across the Developer Platform org, and shape company strategy on how the platform creates value for both developers and Discord. Strengthen the developer side of the value equation by shaping developer\-facing data products, including metric definitions, benchmarking methodologies, and insight quality. Strengthen the Discord side of the value equation by partnering with Ads, Engagement, and Growth to identify, validate, and productize platform\-derived signals, and by measuring their incremental value through experimentation. Drive platform adoption by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Business Development to measure integration health, forecast growth, and surface insights that help the org land and deepen integrations with the world's largest game developers. Serve as a trusted analytical partner to top game developers, designing joint studies with partner data science teams to uncover business value from the developer tech stack. Partner with Data Engineering, Product, and Legal on data governance: ensure platform signals are documented, discoverable, and governed well across Discord. Set clear priorities and nimble operating models, and build a team known for rigorous methods and decision\-ready work. Partner with other Data leaders to shape the direction and culture of Discord's Data organization.. What you should have 8\+ years of experience in applied data science and advanced analytics, ideally including both consumer product and B2B or platform contexts. 3\+ years managing and developing teams of Data Scientists, with a track record of growing ICs and raising the team's technical bar. Strong expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including quasi\-experimental methods (propensity matching, synthetic controls, diff\-in\-diff) for settings where randomized experiments aren't feasible. Experience designing novel, interpretable metrics for a new or fast\-evolving product area, and building the measurement systems around them. Proficiency in SQL and at least one data programming language (Python or R). Clear communication and influence. You can translate complex technical work into crisp narratives for executives, engineers, and external partners, and use data to shape strategy and roadmaps alongside Product and Engineering leadership. Bonus points Experience with gaming, game platforms, or developer\-facing (B2B2C) products, especially working directly with external partners' data or analytics teams. Experience building or shaping customer\-facing data products such as analytics dashboards, benchmarking tools, or measurement offerings. Familiarity with advertising signal ecosystems (event pipelines, identity resolution, targeting and measurement, lookalike modeling) and with ML applications for signal enrichment, forecasting, or personalization. Experience with cloud data platforms like BigQuery, very large datasets, and modern BI tools (e.g., Hex, Mode, Looker, Tableau). Understanding of data governance, privacy, and responsible data use, particularly for signals shared across product and revenue systems. Interest in Discord, gaming, and the communities we serve. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $342,000 to $380,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.Why Discord?Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clickingHERE.

You will work closely with product and other engineers to deliver and develop backend platform service features in a scalable and secure manner. You will use your experience working with production web applications at scale to design, implement and maintain RESTful and GRPC APIs, micro services and integrations with external services. A successful person in this role will want to work in an environment where you are challenged to continue learning and growing. Where your voice and opinions will be heard and you can make a real difference. You will work closely with Product Management, Core Engineering, and internal Business and Partner teams to enable delivering value to customers faster. Docusign is transforming the way that our customers create, commit, and manage agreements. Our team is working on highly visible and impactful work to simplify and modernize the way that Docusign packages and manages features across single and multi\-account customers and we need talented developers to help us get there! We move at a fast pace, solve hard problems, and are continuously innovating in the space and raising the bar. If you share our enthusiasm for building robust distributed systems, this is the team for you. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Software Engineering. **Responsibility** * Design, develop and maintain modern web features and service integrations for our backend platform services * Deliver secure, performant, scalable and reusable enterprise quality code utilizing Agile practices and a Continuous Integration and Deployment CI/CD pipeline * Collaborate through code reviews, pair programming and online remote communication to help ensure we ship scalable, secure and highly available code * Mentor team members who are learning skills which you have mastered * Keep current with the latest software engineering best practices and share with the team to continuously increase quality, efficiency and productivity * Apply strong analytical skills and ability to investigate and update code that you are unfamiliar with **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other related engineering field, or comparable industry experience within a software organization * 3\+ years of experience implementing and maintaining backend services, including RESTful or grpc API endpoints using a modern software language and/or framework * Experience with server\-side development * Experience with microservice architecture, design, and implementation on Azure, AWS, GCP or other cloud environments * Experience writing logging, monitoring, alerts and dashboards to detect and diagnose live issues **Preferred** * Experience developing in C\# * Experience working in an agile development environment * Experience in integrating with web\-based products * Strong organizational, problem\-solving and communication skills * A demonstrated willingness to assist other team members through brainstorming, mentorship, pair\-programming, knowledge\-sharing and creative problem solving **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
