jobs.title: Senior 5G MAC Software Engineer
jobs.description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E\-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper\-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly\-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space\-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. ### **What you will do:** * Own the software architecture, redesign, implementation, and integration of MAC\-side software for a new 5G NR physical layer, including PHY integration, emulation, and test capabilities. * Define a portable, layered architecture that separates MAC behavior, the MAC\-PHY interface, platform transport, and operating\-system services. Support host\-based simulation, execution on a simulated ARM processor, and deployment on FPGA and ASIC platforms. * Define and evolve the MAC\-PHY interface, including message sequencing, timing, buffer ownership, compatibility, versioning, and error handling. Coordinate changes with PHY and protocol\-stack engineers. * Implement and debug real\-time control and data flows for terrestrial 5G NR, including PDCCH, PDSCH, PUSCH, PUCCH, PRACH, SRS, HARQ, CQI, timing advance, and measurements. * Design low\-power communication between ARM software and PHY firmware using shared memory, mailboxes, interrupts, and efficient data movement. Address concurrency, cache coherency, memory ordering, backpressure, timeouts, and recovery. * Extend the SystemC TLM virtual platform, with guidance from system designers, and carry the software through FPGA and ASIC integration. Debug system\-level failures on simulated and physical SoCs. * Build automated regressions, test\-vector flows, traces, and KPI checks that correlate behavior across simulation and hardware. * Review architecture and code, coordinate dependencies across software, firmware, systems, verification, and hardware teams, and gradually expand into production MAC development. ### **What you bring to this role:** * Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering embedded C/C\+\+ software for a wireless modem, baseband, or comparable real\-time, resource\-constrained system. * Practical knowledge of 5G NR MAC and relevant 3GPP specifications, including terrestrial operation, scheduling, HARQ, random access, and MAC\-PHY interactions. * Hands\-on experience debugging heterogeneous SoCs and hardware\-software interfaces involving shared memory, mailboxes, interrupts, DMA or similar data movement, cache coherency, and multicore synchronization. * Experience developing embedded Linux software and working with an RTOS. * Working knowledge of digital communications and DSP sufficient to understand PHY processing constraints, timing, and data flow. * Ability to decompose complex systems into clear components and interfaces, make sound architectural tradeoffs, diagnose integration failures, and collaborate effectively across software and hardware teams. * A track record of independent technical ownership, supported by reproducible tests, version control, and clear design documentation. * Typical background: BS with 7\+ years, MS with 5\+ years, or PhD with 3\+ years of relevant experience in wireless communications, embedded software, computer engineering, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated expertise is also welcome; these are guidelines rather than mandatory minimums. ### **Bonus points for the following:** * Experience modifying SystemC TLM virtual platforms or integrating production software with virtual hardware models. * Experience taking embedded modem software through FPGA prototyping, pre\-silicon verification, ASIC bring\-up, and hardware correlation. * Experience designing or extending a MAC\-PHY interface such as FAPI, nFAPI, or a proprietary equivalent. * Experience with Zephyr, FreeRTOS, vector DSPs, or heterogeneous ARM and DSP SoCs. * Experience optimizing modem or baseband software for low power. * Experience with 5G NR non\-terrestrial networks, including propagation delay, timing advance, Doppler\-related coordination, or NTN scheduling and HARQ. * Experience contributing to production protocol\-stack software, including MAC, RLC, RRC, or a MAC\-PHY adaptation layer. ### **Additional Requirements** This is a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment \- flexibility to occasionally work extended hours or weekends during critical periods is expected. $140,000 \- $200,000 a year This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Santa Clara office. The target base pay for this position is $140,000 \- $200,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in\-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow\-ed. E\-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role. **Why E\-Space is right for you:** As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals. In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high\-growth industry. We want you to make the most of your journey at E\-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well\-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E\-Space:* An opportunity to really make a difference * Sustainability at our core * Fair and honest workplace * Innovative thinking is encouraged * Competitive salaries * Continuous learning and development * Health and wellness care options * Financial solutions for the future * Optional legal services (US only) * Paid holidays * Paid time off We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Data Analyst II-Business Analyst Focus
jobs.description: Description: Education Analytics (EA) is a nonprofit organization that partners with states, school districts, and education organizations to improve student outcomes through data, analytics, and technology. We believe better data systems and collaborative technology can help education leaders make more informed decisions that positively impact students. EA is seeking a Data Analyst II (Business Analyst Focus) to join our team. In this role, you’ll connect partner and user needs to data, analytics, and technical solutions. You’ll work to understand the questions education leaders are trying to answer, translate those needs into clear data definitions and analytic requirements, and help ensure that reports, dashboards, and data products provide meaningful and useful information. You’ll work closely with education partners, analysts, engineers, and other technical teams throughout the analytic process. Depending on project needs, you may conduct partner discovery, define and document analytic requirements, map source data to reporting concepts, investigate data quality, develop technical specifications, mock up reports or dashboards, and help guide projects from initial problem definition through delivery. This is a newer role type at EA that builds on our existing technical analytics work with greater emphasis on user needs, data definitions, analytic requirements, and the connection between data systems and how information is ultimately used. People in this role will have opportunities to help shape how this work develops at EA. EA will consider candidates with a range of experience and qualifications for placement at the Data Analyst I, Data Analyst II, or Senior Data Analyst level. The level and responsibilities will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated capabilities. This position is based on\-site at EA’s downtown Madison, WI office. Remote work may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience. Candidates may come from a variety of professional backgrounds. We encourage applicants with experience as Business Analysts, Data Analysts, BI Analysts, BI Developers, Data Scientists, education data specialists, or in similar roles that combine technical data work with understanding and translating user needs to apply. Requirements: * Experience turning broad or ambiguous requests into clear questions, data definitions, analytic requirements, and technical specifications, and communicating those needs across technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience investigating complex data sources, assessing data quality, and determining how data should be mapped, combined, transformed, and interpreted for reporting and analytics. * Working proficiency with SQL, including the ability to write, interpret, and debug complex queries in a cloud data warehouse environment, such as Snowflake. * Familiarity with education data standards such as Ed\-Fi, or demonstrated ability to learn and apply complex data standards, definitions, and reporting rules. * Experience working with business intelligence, reporting, or data visualization tools and engaging in the mockup phase, with Apache Superset and Figma experience preferred. * Experience using a statistical programming language to investigate, process, or validate data, with R or Python preferred. * Experience using Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. * Comfort working in an evolving technical environment and adopting new tools, including AI\-assisted technologies, to improve the efficiency and quality of analytical work. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment with limited direction. **Qualifications** * Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Information Systems, Public Policy, Education, or a related field. * At least one year of relevant professional experience, including progressively independent work with data, analytics, technical requirements, or data products. * Familiarity with K–12 education data, state or district reporting, or education data standards is helpful but not required. **Compensation and Benefits** The base salary range for the Data Analyst II position is $72,000–$84,000, depending on experience and qualifications. EA may also consider candidates for placement at the Data Analyst I or Senior Data Analyst level; compensation would be adjusted accordingly based on the level at which the candidate is hired. EA's benefits include: * A 12% non\-elective contribution each payroll from EA to your 401k retirement plan, once eligible per plan rules. * Up to a 3% salary deferral match each payroll by EA to your 401k, once eligible and contributing, per plan rules. * 26\.5 days of paid vacation annually (accrued at the rate of 17\.67 hours per month). * 40 hours of paid sick time provided on date of hire plus 8 hours of paid sick time that accrued monthly. * 9 paid holidays, including EA\-designated holidays or the option to swap holidays of your choosing. * 85% of health insurance premium paid for by EA, 50% of dental premiums paid for by EA. * Paid parental leave, after one year of employment and if all other eligibility requirements are met * Employer\-Paid Short\-Term Disability. Employer\-Paid Long\-Term Disability. * Employer\-Paid Group Life Insurance: Coverage equal to 2x your annual salary, up to $200,000\. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential support and resources available to you and your eligible family members.

jobs.title: Mobile Automation Maintenance Technician
jobs.description: #### **OVERVIEW** Electrolit Manufacturing USA (EMUSA) is a new, state\-of\-the\-art beverage manufacturing facility in Waco, TX. The 640,000 sqft. Facility is situated in the Texas Central Industrial Park and will be operating on a 24/7 schedule. The facility will manufacture and distribute the 26 flavors of Electrolit™ \- the fastest growing isotonic hydration beverage in the US. #### **POSITION SUMMARY** The Automation Maintenance Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and optimizing automated material\-handling and production systems. The role supports the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of PLC\-controlled equipment, robotics, conveyors, E80 LGV systems, battery charging stations, pallet conveyor systems, and associated electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and control components. Working closely with the Embedded Automation Engineer, the technician will progressively develop the technical expertise required to assume increased ownership of the maintenance, reliability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the E80 LGV fleet, including Rear Wheel Drive, Pantograph, and Reach vehicle models. The position requires a strong combination of electrical, automation, and mechanical maintenance skills to maximize equipment availability, system performance, and operational efficiency. This position is intended to serve as the primary backup and succession role for the Embedded Automation Engineer, with the expectation that the technician will progressively assume increased responsibility for the maintenance, reliability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the E80 LGV fleet, charging infrastructure, and pallet conveyor systems. #### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** #### **Equipment Maintenance and Troubleshooting** * Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair automation equipment, electrical systems, PLC controls, robotics, conveyors, and automated materialhandling systems. * Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on automated equipment. * Respond to equipment breakdowns and restore operations while minimizing downtime. * Complete root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring equipment failures. * Monitor system performance and identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability and availability. * Mechanical Systems Maintenance * Inspect, diagnose, repair, and replace mechanical components including drive assemblies, wheel systems, bearings, gearboxes, chains, sprockets, couplings, belts, and conveyor components. * Perform maintenance and troubleshooting of LGV mechanical systems including steering mechanisms, drive units, loadhandling devices, pantographs, reach mechanisms, hydraulic lift systems, and structural assemblies. * Maintain and repair hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromechanical systems used in automated materialhandling equipment. * Perform alignment, adjustment, lubrication, and calibration of mechanical components to ensure optimal equipment performance and longevity. * Inspect equipment for wear, vibration, misalignment, and mechanical degradation, implementing corrective actions before failures occur. * Support installation, rebuild, and replacement of motors, gearboxes, actuators, and other critical mechanical assemblies. #### **Automation System Support** * Support, maintain, and troubleshoot E80 LGV systems including Rear Wheel Drive, Hydraulic Lift, Pantograph, and Reach vehicle models, battery charging systems, navigation equipment, safety devices, fleetmanagement software, drive motors, hydraulic systems, and loadhandling mechanisms. * Perform inspections and preventive maintenance on LGV mechanical, electrical, and control systems to ensure maximum fleet availability and performance. * Troubleshoot PLCs, HMIs, sensors, motors, drives, VFDs, industrial networks, and control panels. * Assist with equipment commissioning, system upgrades, software updates, and validation activities. * Coordinate with automation vendors and technical support teams when advanced troubleshooting is required. * Assist in managing critical spare parts inventory for LGVs, battery chargers, conveyor systems, and associated automation equipment. #### **Reliability and Continuous Improvement** * Analyze equipment performance and maintenance history to improve reliability and reduce repeat failures. * Participate in continuous improvement, Kaizen, and costreduction initiatives. * Develop and improve preventivemaintenance tasks, inspection standards, and predictivemaintenance practices. * Recommend equipment modifications that improve safety, throughput, maintainability, and equipment life. * Support reliabilitycentered maintenance initiatives for LGVs, conveyor systems, and automated materialhandling equipment. #### **Documentation and Compliance** * Maintain accurate work orders, maintenance records, parts usage, and equipment history in the designated system. * Create and update maintenance procedures, work instructions, inspection   be assessed using measurable metrics, which may include but are not limited to: * Production output and throughput targets. * Accuracy and quality rates. * Adherence to safety, regulatory, and compliance standards. * Equipment uptime, utilization, and operational efficiency. * Ontime completion and schedule adherence. * Participation in and contribution to continuous improvement initiatives. #### **QUALIFICATIONS** * Minimum of 3 years of experience in automation, intralogistics, manufacturing, warehouse automation, or industrialequipment environments. * Experience maintaining industrial mechanical systems including conveyors, hydraulic systems, gearboxes, bearings, drive assemblies, and automated materialhandling equipment. * Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and problemsolving skills. * Experience in customerfacing or operationalsupport technical roles. * Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, hydraulic diagrams, and equipment documentation. * Working knowledge of industrial safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO). * Working knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic systems, mechanical powertransmission components, and industrial maintenance best practices. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex electromechanical systems involving electrical controls, mechanical components, and automation equipment. * Experience with batterycharging systems, industrial mobile equipment, and automated guided vehicles is preferred. * Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends and oncall support when required. #### **WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This position is performed primarily in a manufacturing and production environment within a beverage manufacturing facility. The work environment may include exposure to moving mechanical parts, automated and manual production equipment, wet or humid conditions, temperature variations, and moderate to high noise levels. Employees may be required to work on elevated work surfaces, platforms, ladders, or stairs, and in or around confined or restricted spaces in accordance with applicable safety procedures and training. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is required and must be worn at all times while on the production floor or in designated work areas, in accordance with OSHA standards and company safety policies. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, balance, push, pull, and use hands and arms to operate machinery, tools, and equipment. The role involves repetitive motions, sustained physical activity, and maintaining situational awareness in a dynamic production environment. The employee must be able to regularly lift and/or move objects weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without assistance. Work schedules may include extended shifts, overtime, weekends, and/or holidays based on production demands. #### **OTHER REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be able to lift 30 lbs. * Must be able to comfortably use ladders and step stools. * Written Communication: Understands and clearly conveys information in writing. * Reading Comprehension: Interprets written instructions and jobrelated documents. * Critical Thinking: Evaluated information and solutions using logic and reasoning * Active Listening: Listens attentively and responds appropriately. * Employee must abide by our company values; Humility, Honesty, Mutual Respect and Equitable Treatment of All, Dependability and Accountability, and Initiative. #### **FOOD SAFETY** This role supports the company’s commitment to compliance by following food safety protocols, staying up to date through ongoing training, and helping build a culture where food safety and accountability are part of everyday work. Electrolit Manufacturing Inc. is committed to maintaining a work environment that promotes diversity and is free of discrimination. Except where prohibited by state law, all offers of employment might be subject of passing a drug test.

jobs.title: EverHealth - Lead Software Engineer (Remote, US)
jobs.description: **Lead Software Engineer, EverHealth – Remote (US)** EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com. We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/ **EverHealth,** a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end\-to\-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000\+ healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of SaaS products including DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, eProviderSolutions, AlertMD, and MD Coder. With two EHRs and platform\-level solutions such as communication platforms and a clearinghouse, EverHealth delivers a turn\-key, end\-to\-end solution for the software needs of a modern healthcare practice. We are looking for a **Lead Software Engineer IV** to focus on **EverHealth’s revenue cycle management (RCM) platform**. RCM is at the heart of how our customers get paid, and we are building a new generation of RCM tools that pair modern workflow software with AI agents to help billing teams work smarter, resolve issues faster, and collect more of what they’ve earned. This work is part of our broader focus on finding where automation, AI, and new experiences can make the biggest impact across the EverHealth portfolio. As a Lead Software Engineer IV, you will be one of the hands\-on technical leads on a small, nimble team building an AI\-enabled RCM task\-management platform end to end. Our initial focus spans the front\-end task\-driven user experience, the backend services and event\-driven workflows behind it, the API layer that translates between our platform and the systems it connects to, and the code that invokes and coordinates AI agents working alongside our users. This is a product engineering role. The right person cares as much about the problem as the technology: understanding how billing teams actually work, spending time with end users and business leaders in conjunction with our product and design partners, and shipping outcomes that measurably improve their day. You will help set technical direction, ship a lot of code, and raise the bar for the engineers around you, using AI throughout the development lifecycle to move quickly without cutting corners. As the platform matures, the scope will grow with it, and you will have the opportunity to help shape where automation, AI, and new experiences can deliver the most value across our products. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the design and delivery of a full\-stack RCM worklist platform, from the user interface through backend services, APIs, and the data model * Build and evolve event\-driven services and workflows that route, prioritize, and track work across people and AI agents * Design and maintain the API and translation layer that connects the platform with EverHealth products, our clearinghouse, and third\-party systems * Build the application code that invokes, coordinates, and monitors AI agents, including guardrails, human review steps, and observability * Own data modeling and schema design, writing performant SQL and making effective use of ORMs * Partner directly with end users, product, operations, and business leaders to understand workflows, define problems, and measure outcomes * Share ownership of technical direction and engineering standards, and mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions * Champion AI\-assisted development across planning, design, coding, testing, review, and operations * Build secure, reliable, HIPAA\-compliant software backed by strong testing, monitoring, and operational practices * Help identify and evaluate new opportunities for automation, AI, and new experiences across the EverHealth portfolio **Technology Environment:** * Cloud Infrastructure: AWS * Languages: Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent * Architectural Patterns: API\-first services and event\-driven architectures * Data Platforms: modern relational databases such as Postgres, MySQL, and MSSQL * AI: LLM and agent\-based capabilities integrated into product workflows * Security \& Compliance: HIPAA\-compliant systems and secure healthcare data handling **Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including leading technical direction for a team * Strong full\-stack engineering skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent languages, with a track record of shipping production systems across UI, backend, and APIs * Experience designing and building event\-based systems, such as message queues, event streams, and asynchronous workflows * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with modern databases, ORMs, and schema design * Proficient and productive in leveraging AI across all aspects of the software development lifecycle * A product engineering mindset focused on solving problems and delivering outcomes, not just technology * Ability to collaborate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders, including end users and business leaders, and translate their needs into working software * Comfort working on a small team with high ownership and an evolving scope * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Nice to Have:** * Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into production software, including orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Healthcare/RCM experience, such as claims, EDI 837/835, eligibility, denial and A/R workflows, and HIPAA **Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. **This role can be based anywhere in the United States.** Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. **Benefits and Perks:** * Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid * Continued investment in your professional development * Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend * 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting * Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off * Employee Stock Purchase Program **Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $170,000 to $195,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience! EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI\-assisted work.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
jobs.description: About Evergreen Goodwill Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization founded in 1923 that helps people get jobs across Northwest Washington by offering high\-quality free job training, education and job placement. Goodwill empowers individuals to overcome barriers to working, by providing comprehensive support and connecting them with life changing job opportunities, ensuring they are career\-ready and can support themselves and their families. The organization employs over 2,000 people, operates five job\-training centers, 23 nonprofit retail stores and more than 27 donation sites in King, Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom and Kitsap Counties. Every day, Evergreen Goodwill connects people with the jobs, services and skills they need — because Jobs Change Lives. We are committed to creating and sustaining a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion (DEI) and are focused on creating a joyful, inclusive and successful organization. Enterprise Solutions Architect **Reports to:** VP of Technology **Supervises:** None **Job Site:** Evergreen Goodwill Administration Office, Hybrid 3 days required in office **Band:** $145,000 – $155,000 Position Summary Translates technology strategy into enterprise architecture and technical standards. Accountable for the coherence and long\-term consequences of architectural decisions within the direction established with the VP of Technology. Sets technical planning, architecture review, and release coordination practices across engineering. Advises leadership on sequencing, dependencies, capacity constraints, and technical risk. Evergreen Goodwill is seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect. This is an internal\-facing, hands\-on architecture role — not a pre\-sales or customer\-facing position. Technology direction is set with the VP of Technology. Your work is to turn that direction into an architecture the organization can actually build against: the target state, the integration patterns, the standards, and the sequence to get there. **We are in the middle of a substantial platform transformation:** automating sort and warehouse operations, migrating identity and productivity platforms, integrating finance systems, and building software in\-house where commercial products do not fit how we operate. These initiatives share dependencies. A decision made in identity constrains what is possible in the warehouse; a decision made in finance integration constrains reporting. You are accountable for making those decisions compose — and for their consequences three years out, not only at deployment. You will write the architecture and the standards down so they outlast any individual, including you. You will be senior enough to say no with a reason, and close enough to the work to be credible when you do. **You will also set how engineering plans and ships:** technical planning practice, architecture review, the DevOps pipeline, and release coordination — the air traffic control function for what reaches production and when, across teams running concurrent, interdependent initiatives. Where that work surfaces sequencing conflicts, capacity constraints, or technical risk, you bring it to leadership early enough to act on. Key Responsibilities Architecture and technical direction * Rationalize and articulate the target\-state architecture across infrastructure, applications, integration, and data — and the sequenced path from current state to it * Develop and document platform selection and exit recommendations against explicit criteria — total cost, integration burden, exit cost, security posture, and organizational fit — and own the resulting architecture once the direction is set * Define integration patterns and interface contracts between systems so teams are not negotiating them case by case * Maintain architectural decision records stating what was decided, what alternatives were considered, and why — with enough reasoning that a future engineer can tell whether the decision still applies * Build security, privacy, and compliance requirements into the architecture — PCI scope, data handling, retention, and the access model — rather than bolting them on after a system is built Engineering standards and practice * Set and own development, deployment, and lifecycle standards across all three engineering families: source control, environments, release process, configuration management, testing, and operational handoff * Define what "production\-ready" means for internally built software, and hold work to it * Build the reusable patterns, templates, and reference implementations that let teams move quickly inside the standards rather than around them Quality, DevOps, and change management * Own the quality bar for engineering work across the organization: what gets reviewed, what "done" means, and what is allowed to reach production * Own the build and deployment pipeline — source control practice, branching strategy, automated testing, environment  lassification patterns, and a clear view of where these approaches fail * Experience running change review or a comparable forum where sequencing and risk get arbitrated between teams with competing deadlines * Hands\-on software development experience current enough to be credible with practicing engineers — able to read and write production code, not only review architecture * Experience making build\-versus\-buy decisions and living with the consequences of both * Clear technical writing, plus the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical executive audience without flattening it * Experience in an environment where the architecture is partly inherited and cannot be replaced wholesale Other / Preferred Qualifications * Retail, logistics, warehouse operations, or another environment with physical operations and frontline staff * Organizations running internal software development alongside commercial platforms * Nonprofit, public sector, or mission\-driven experience, or comparable experience under real budget constraint * Identity and access architecture, point\-of\-sale or payment systems, ERP integration, or data platform architecture — depth in one with working knowledge across the others is more useful here than breadth alone * Contribution to security and compliance standards, including PCI * Experience with change control in an environment with seasonal freeze periods or revenue\-sensitive release windows * Familiarity with delivery and quality metrics — change failure rate, lead time, rollback frequency — used to drive practice rather than to report upward What we are deliberately not asking for * People management experience. No direct reports; not a step toward management. This is the top of the individual contributor track * Specific vendor certifications. Platforms in our current environment are examples, not requirements — we are replacing several of them * Pre\-sales or customer\-facing solution architecture. Different discipline; this role is entirely internal Minimum Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field. Demonstrated architectural work carries more weight than credentials. Minimum Years of Relevant Experience 12\+ years, including 5\+ in an architecture\-accountable role. Everyone Is Welcome When you join Evergreen Goodwill, you join a truly vibrant community. We value the things that make us different and unique. From diverse international and ethnic backgrounds, to languages, identities, ages, orientations, and beyond, Evergreen Goodwill celebrates individual and cultural diversity. Why work at Evergreen Goodwill? Sr. Solutions Engineer **Reports to:** Director, Technology **Supervises:** None **Location:** Evergreen Goodwill Administration Office, Hybrid 3 days required in office **Salary Range:** $90,000 – $100,000 Position Summary Evergreen Goodwill is seeking a Sr. Solutions Engineer to own a domain of the systems our organization runs on — the platforms, integrations, and automations that keep a 2,000\-person nonprofit operating across 26 locations. This is an internal\-facing engineering role, not a pre\-sales position. You will take ownership of a set of business\-critical systems: how they are designed, how they connect to everything else, and how they behave when something breaks. We are modernizing much of our technology estate. You will be designing and building replacements, not maintaining a finished stack — and you will own the standards for how that work gets done in your domain. This is a senior individual contributor role with real decision authority. You will work directly with the business areas you support, and you will be the person who decides how the systems in your domain fit together. Where your authority sits. You decide within the systems you own. Standards that span domains — how your systems talk to everyone else's, how things get deployed and changed — sit with our Enterprise Solutions Architect, and you help shape them. Inside your domain, the calls are yours. Key Responsibilities Domain ownership * Own the architecture and forward plan for a domain of business\-critical systems * Own the integrations between your domain and the rest of the enterprise estate — finance, workforce, inventory, and reporting * Own configuration standards, release practice, and operational handoff for your domain, working within enterprise architecture standards Build and integration * Design, build, and deploy integrations, automations, and configuration across the domain * Own production codebases where the domain includes internally built software * Build AI into the systems you own where it earns its place — classification, extraction, retrieval, and language\-model services wired into real workflows, with evaluation against the task rather than adoption by default * Tier 3 diagnosis for the systems you own — the escalation point, not an escalation path Reliability and operations * Own reliability and service levels for the systems in your domain, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response * Design the operational handoff so systems support teams can run what you build * Participate in change and maintenance windows, including business\-sensitive timing Stakeholder partnership * Partner directly with the business areas you support. jobs.description: ### **The Role** You'll build, grow, and scale partner practices across our channel and managed service provider (MSP) network, serving as the technical and product expert across the full partner lifecycle. Instead of focusing solely on individual deals, you will enable entire partner organizations, coaching their technical practitioners and delivery teams to independently deliver solutions on Everlaw's Tu/Fr.** #### **What you'll do** * Serve as the technical expert across the partner lifecycle, evaluating prospective partners' delivery capabilities and translating complex workflow requirements into platform\-native solutions. * Build onboarding programs, technical playbooks, certification paths, and demonstration enablement materials that accelerate partner ramp\-up and independence. * Deliver polished demonstrations and technical deep dives (including generative AI capabilities and API integration architectures) to technical and executive stakeholders. * Partner with Business Development and direct sales teams on strategic joint opportunities, RFP responses, and co\-sell pursuits. * Act as an escalation point and technical mentor for partner\-side solutions architects, consulting on how Everlaw fits into broader legal technology stacks. * Gather field insights from partner engagements to collaborate with product and engineering teams on platform features and API surface expansion. #### **About You** * You have 3\+ years of experience in a sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role, with roughly 8\+ years of total technology experience and deep hands\-on expertise with legal technology platforms. * You bring a proven track record of working with managed service providers or legal industry delivery teams, with the ability to coach and enable other technical practitioners. * You have strong technical acumen and a solid command of litigation technology processes, data processing, analytics, and platform integrations. * You are an excellent communicator and presenter who can influence both delivery engineers and partner executives. * You are organized and process\-oriented, comfortable managing long partnership cycles, concurrent enablement workstreams, and up to 25% travel. * You are authorized to work in the United States. We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. Through discovery, tailored demonstrations, technical deep dives, evaluations, and solution design, the team translates complex legal workflows into a clear vision of what better work can look like. This work gives customers confidence in Everlaw while bringing field insights back into the company's product and strategy. ### **Total Rewards \& Benefits** The annual base salary for this position is $172,000, with a total On\-Target Earnings (OTE) of $246,000\. Eligibility for the commission portion is performance\-based and subject to the achievement of specific performance metrics, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate's experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future. **Health \& well\-being** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses * Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness * Paid parental leave * Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance **Financial rewards** * Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth * 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation **Growth \& everyday perks** * 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave * Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year * Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues * Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics * Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup * Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices ### **About Everlaw** When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence (emails, documents, chats, files) to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours. We're the kind of place that's ranked \#1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career\-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you. * \#LI\-BL1 * \#LI\-Hybrid About Everlaw *At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re\-wires the legal industry, at a category\-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.* Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We respect the gender, gender identity and gender expression of our applicants and employees, and we honor requests for pronouns. It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, including the California Equal Pay Act. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We collect and process the personal information you provided along with your job application in accordance with our Applicants Privacy Notice and Notice at Collection. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Ezee Fiber, our success is built on delivering **Speed, Simplicity, and Service** in everything we do. Guided by our core values of **Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, and Collaboration**, we empower our employees to do the right thing, support one another, take ownership of their work, and work together to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers and the communities we serve. The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds, optimizes, and supports scalable data infrastructure and business logic that enable network performance analysis, customer insights, operational reporting, and enterprise analytics. Building on Ezee Fiber's Data Engineer scope, this senior\-level role owns complex data engineering solutions, establishes technical standards, improves data reliability and performance, and provides technical guidance across data initiatives. The role partners with technical and business stakeholders to ensure data is accessible, secure, accurate, well\-governed, and actionable in a fast\-paced, fiber\-focused environment.* Design, develop, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from CRM, OSS/BSS, GIS, network monitoring tools, REST APIs, and other enterprise platforms. * Write efficient, reusable, production\-quality Python and SQL code to process, transform, validate, and serve large and complex datasets. * Lead the design and implementation of automated data\-quality controls, anomaly detection, monitoring, alerting, and remediation processes. * Design and optimize data models, data lakes, data warehouses, and related architecture to support business intelligence, analytics, and operational use cases. * Own and enhance data infrastructure across cloud and on\-premise environments, including platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, MS SQL, and PostgreSQL. * Evaluate pipeline and platform performance, identify scalability or reliability risks, and implement technical improvements that increase resiliency and efficiency. * Establish and promote engineering standards for data pipelines, schemas, documentation, testing, deployment, observability, and version control. * Partner with Engineering, Field Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, Marketing, and other stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data solutions. * Provide technical leadership on data initiatives, including solution design, architecture decisions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and guidance to less\-experienced engineers or technical partners. * Define and maintain trusted datasets and data products that support dashboards, performance metrics, forecasting, and executive decision\-making. * Ensure data solutions comply with Ezee Fiber standards for security, privacy, compliance, access controls, and data governance. * Support data lineage, metadata, documentation, and data\-integrity practices across systems and applications. * Lead or support integration of real\-time or near\-real\-time data using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, APIs, or comparable tools. * Identify opportunities to automate manual data processes, reduce technical debt, and improve the quality, speed, and reliability of data delivery. * Independently diagnose and resolve complex production data issues and communicate risks, impacts, and recommended solutions to technical and business stakeholders

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Level 3
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** We build insurance software for complex, highly regulated healthcare environments, where a defect doesn't just fail a test, it can mean a denied claim, a coverage gap, or a compliance failure for the organizations that rely on us. We partner closely with clients to evolve these systems in their real operating environments, not in isolation. **THE OPPORTUNITY** Join a high\-impact engineering team where you'll play a key role in designing, automating, and optimizing the cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms that power our products and services. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll help shape secure, scalable, and reliable solutions across AWS and Azure while driving automation, platform modernization, CI/CD excellence, operational readiness, and cloud best practices. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on engineering. You'll partner closely with software developers, security, and technology teams to improve system performance, strengthen reliability, streamline deployments, and enhance the overall developer experience. Success requires balancing scalability, security, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness while delivering practical solutions aligned with business priorities. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, continuously improving systems and processes, and leveraging modern cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to deliver measurable business value, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact across the organization. **OUR DEVOPS ECOSYSTEM** You'll work in a modern cloud\-native environment supporting innovative healthcare technology solutions. Our platform spans AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and Docker container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Partnering closely with software engineering teams, you'll help build and evolve scalable microservices\-based platforms while driving automation, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence. Technologies include: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Python, Java, React, Prometheus, Datadog, ELK, Jira, and Confluence. **WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GREAT HERE** * **Ownership over task completion.** You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and operational impacts while driving initiatives through implementation and production support. * **Systems thinking.** You understand how applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, security, deployment pipelines, and business objectives connect, and you make decisions accordingly. * **Automation with purpose.** You use Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and automation to improve reliability, scalability, consistency, and efficiency while avoiding unnecessary complexity. * **Judgment in ambiguity.** You navigate complex problems, competing priorities, and evolving requirements with practical decision\-making and a focus on business outcomes. * **Reliability mindset.** You measure success not only by delivery speed, but by stability, observability, security, recoverability, and long\-term maintainability. * **Team\-first leadership.** You share knowledge, mentor others, and help elevate engineering practices through collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. **EDUCATION** High School Diploma or equivalent is required. A degree in computer science, software engineering or related field is preferred. **PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND** Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including: * DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related experience supporting software delivery, infrastructure, and operational environments. * AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms, including deployment, administration, monitoring, security, reliability, and operational support activities. * CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, release management, and software delivery tooling such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or comparable platforms. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and environment automation using Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. * Containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or comparable platforms. * Monitoring, logging, observability, incident response, operational support, system reliability, and platform performance management. * Scripting, automation, and tooling using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, or comparable technologies. * Collaboration with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, Quality Assurance, and other stakeholders to support delivery, reliability, and operational objectives. * Large, complex software implementation, integration, enhancement, modernization, or platform initiatives within distributed, cloud\-hosted, and highly collaborative environments. * Security, compliance, governance, and operational igration Reform and Control Act (IRCA), and does not discriminate based on citizenship or national origin. **EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY \& PRE\-EMPLOYMENT SCREENING NOTICE** Our Company participates in E\-Verify as part of certain client contractual requirements. In accordance with federal law, all new hires must complete Form I\-9 and provide documentation acceptable to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to verify their identity and authorization to work in the United States within three (3\) business days of their start date. For more information on employment eligibility verification and acceptable documentation, visit the DHS website at: https://www.uscis.gov/i\-9\-central/form\-i\-9\-acceptable\-documents As a condition of employment, all candidates and employees are subject to a background check and drug screening. These screenings are required by Company policy and by client contractual obligations and are conducted in compliance with the federal Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and all applicable federal, state, and local laws. The scope of drug testing may vary by state, depending on applicable state and local laws. **WORK LOCATION** **This position is designated as hybrid and requires regular in\-office work in one of the following offices: Boca Raton, FL or Denver, CO or Midtown New York City. This is not a remote role**. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Level 3
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** We build insurance software for complex, highly regulated healthcare environments, where a defect doesn't just fail a test, it can mean a denied claim, a coverage gap, or a compliance failure for the organizations that rely on us. We partner closely with clients to evolve these systems in their real operating environments, not in isolation. **THE OPPORTUNITY** Join a high\-impact engineering team where you'll play a key role in designing, automating, and optimizing the cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms that power our products and services. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll help shape secure, scalable, and reliable solutions across AWS and Azure while driving automation, platform modernization, CI/CD excellence, operational readiness, and cloud best practices. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on engineering. You'll partner closely with software developers, security, and technology teams to improve system performance, strengthen reliability, streamline deployments, and enhance the overall developer experience. Success requires balancing scalability, security, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness while delivering practical solutions aligned with business priorities. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, continuously improving systems and processes, and leveraging modern cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to deliver measurable business value, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact across the organization. **OUR DEVOPS ECOSYSTEM** You'll work in a modern cloud\-native environment supporting innovative healthcare technology solutions. Our platform spans AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and Docker container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Partnering closely with software engineering teams, you'll help build and evolve scalable microservices\-based platforms while driving automation, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence. jobs.title: Director, Production Partner Management
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **About our New Venture** ------------------------- This organization is a new, U.S.\-incorporated manufacturing platform built to serve frontier\-technology industries — humanoid robotics, aerospace, agricultural technology, and healthcare — where reshoring, national security priorities, and speed\-to\-production are reshaping how and where hardware gets built. Backed by MISUMI Group, a global leader in manufacturing solutions and precision components, this venture combines precision machining, final assembly/test/packaging (FATP), supply chain orchestration, and engineering services into a single U.S.\-based platform. Our founding customers include leading humanoid robotics companies, and is being built from day one to grow with a broader roster of frontier\-technology manufacturers as capacity comes online. **Position Summary** -------------------- The Director, Production Partner Management leads the strategy, development, and management of the company's external partner network. This role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and onboarding new partners to our new organization; negotiating and structuring joint venture (JV) and other strategic capacity partnerships, including co\-investment arrangements with equipment providers, staffing partners, and customers; building education and government partnerships that support talent pipelines and manufacturing incentive programs; and ensuring partners meet the quality, capacity, and cost commitments required to support the business. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on manufacturing operations expertise with strong commercial and negotiation skills and is comfortable operating at both the strategic (partnership structuring, JV governance) and tactical (plant floor, supplier performance) levels. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Partner Network Development** * Build and execute a strategy for expanding the company's partner network across target processes, geographies, and capacity tiers. * Source, evaluate, and qualify new partners through capability audits, quality system reviews, and on\-site assessments. * Lead onboarding of new partners, including capability mapping, pricing frameworks, quality agreements, and production ramp plans. **Joint Venture \& Strategic Partnership Structuring** * Identify and evaluate joint venture, co\-investment, and dedicated\-capacity opportunities that expand manufacturing capabilities or secure strategic capacity. * Lead due diligence, business case development, and deal structuring for JV and strategic partnerships to our organization, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and executive leadership. * Negotiate partnership agreements, including terms, governance structures, IP and exclusivity provisions, and commercial terms; represent the company on JV governance or steering committees. * Manage the ongoing partner and JV relationship post\-signing, including performance reviews, capital planning, and expansion decisions. **Equipment, Staffing \& Customer Co\-Investment Partnerships** * Build and negotiate partnerships with capital equipment manufacturers and suppliers to secure financing, leasing, or co\-investment arrangements that expand partner facility capacity. * Develop strategic relationships with staffing and workforce partners to scale labor at partner facilities in line with production ramp and capacity plans. * Structure and negotiate joint investment agreements with key customers to co\-fund dedicated capacity, equipment purchases, or facility expansions in exchange for committed volume or preferred terms. * Evaluate the financial and operational terms of equipment, staffing, and customer co\-investment deals, partnering with Finance and Legal on deal structure and risk allocation. **Education \& Government Partnerships** * Develop and negotiate partnership agreements with technical colleges, universities, and vocational/trade programs to build manufacturing talent pipelines, apprenticeships, and co\-op programs. * Build relationships with federal, state, and local government agencies to identify and secure manufacturing incentive programs, grants, tax credits, and reshoring/onshoring initiatives. * Represent the company with workforce development boards, economic development organizations, and industry associations to advance manufacturing partnership and talent strategy. * Track policy and funding developments relevant to domestic manufacturing capacity and advise leadershi \-Functional Leadership** * Partner closely with Business Development, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams to align partner strategy with product roadmaps and business goals. * Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on partner network health, JV performance, education/government partnership progress, and capacity risk. * Build, mentor, and lead a team of partner managers / supplier development engineers. * Own risk management for the partner portfolio, including geographic concentration, financial health of partners, and supply continuity planning. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree a plus. * 8–12\+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, supplier/partner development, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, with meaningful exposure to contract manufacturing or outsourced production. * Demonstrated experience structuring, negotiating, or managing joint ventures, strategic alliances, or major capacity partnerships in a manufacturing context. * Deep understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g., CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, casting, additive manufacturing, or similar) and quality systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100, or equivalent). * Strong commercial acumen — experience with contract negotiation, pricing models, and partnership economics. * Track record of leading cross\-functional teams and managing complex, multi\-stakeholder relationships. * Willingness and ability to travel 30–50%, including internationally, to partner and prospective partner facilities. **Preferred** * Prior experience in a director\-level or equivalent role leading a partner management, strategic sourcing, or manufacturing operations function. * Experience in digital manufacturing, industrial equipment, automotive, aerospace, medical device, or a comparably regulated manufacturing sector. * Familiarity with capital planning and investment evaluation for joint venture or co\-investment structures. * Experience working with globally distributed manufacturing networks, including partners in Asia, the Americas, and/or Europe. * Experience negotiating agreements with educational institutions (e.g., technical colleges, universities) and/or government agencies (e.g., economic development, workforce boards) in support of manufacturing or workforce initiatives. * Experience negotiating co\-investment or joint funding arrangements with equipment suppliers, staffing partners, or customers. **Success Metrics** ------------------- * Growth and diversification of qualified partner capacity against strategic priorities. * Successful execution of joint venture / strategic partnership deals from evaluation through signed agreement and operational ramp. * Partner network performance against quality, delivery, and cost scorecards. * Reduction of single\-source and geographic concentration risk across the partner portfolio. * Number and value of education and government partnerships established, including talent pipeline agreements and secured incentive/grant funding. * Value of co\-investment secured through equipment, staffing, and customer partnership agreements. **Salary Range:** **$130,000 base salary per year, plus a variable compensation potential of $130,000** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Senior Pega Engineer/Developer
jobs.description: **Description** The Senior Pega Engineer/Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining Pega\-based applications and solutions. The role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software that meets business needs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Pega development, deployment automation, test automation, and general SDLC and DevOps practices. Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. * Design, develop, and test features and functionality for new and existing applications or solutions as part of an Agile Scrum team. * Build and configure applications and business processes using the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business requirements and performance standards. * Communicate effectively with business stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure that development work aligns with business goals. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, QA, DevOps, and operations teams, to deliver high\-quality solutions. * Ensure Pega solutions are configured according to best practices, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance. * Conduct peer reviews of configurations and contribute to the development of best practices and standards. * Become a subject matter expert on one or more areas of functionality within the Pega environment, providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members. * Stay current with Pega technology updates, industry trends, and best practices, and advocate for their adoption. * Accurately document configurations, rules, and any changes made within the Pega environment, ensuring that documentation is kept up\-to\-date and accessible. * Provide regular development updates and status reports to teams and stakeholders, highlighting risks, issues, and progress. * Perform unit and integration testing of Pega configurations as part of the SDLC process, ensuring that they meet functional and performance requirements before deployment. * Collaborate with QA teams to define test strategies, automate testing where possible, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. * Participate in the deployment of Pega applications to production environments, ensuring that deployments are smooth and without issues. * Support and maintain Pega applications, applying patches, fixes, and enhancements as required. * Implement and maintain security best practices within the Pega environment, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations. * Conduct regular security reviews and vulnerability assessments to identify and mitigate potential risks. * Continuously seek opportunities to improve development processes, tools, and practices within the team. * Actively participate in retrospectives and other team activities to drive process improvements. **Education and Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, software engineering, or mathematics. * 6\+ progressive years of experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions and applications in Pega * Must possess a Pega Certified Senior System Administration (CSSA) certification * Big plus if prior/current .NET development experience * Experience in automating deployment processes within Pega environments using tools like Jenkins, Pega Deployment Manager, or other CI/CD pipelines. * Familiarity with Pega’s DevOps capabilities and best practices, including the use of branch\-based development, product rulesets, and automated packaging and deployment. * Proficiency in creating automated test cases within Pega, using tools like PegaUnit, Selenium, or similar frameworks. * Ability to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality. * Understanding of DevOps principles, including infrastructure as code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and continuous monitoring. * Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services as they relate to Pega environments. * Experience in identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks within Pega applications. * Understanding of proactive monitoring and alerting strategies to ensure high availability and reliability of Pega applications. * Experience with integrating Pega with external systems using REST, SOAP, JMS, or other integration technologies. * Familiarity with data transformation and mapping using Pega’s integration rules and connectors. * Knowledge of API management and governance within a Pega environment. * Experience in version control and branching strategies for managing Pega application changes. **Location:** Marlborough/Chelmsford, MA or Hillsboro, OR **Target Compensation:** $116,500 \- $140,000 \+ annual bonus **Schedule:** Monday – Friday \| 8am\-5pm (Hybrid) **Who We Are:** **What makes First Tech different? Click** **here** **to learn more!** Every great journey begins with a bold idea—and ours is no different. First Tech and DCU were founded on the belief that financial solutions should put people first. That belief has fueled decades of innovation and service, rooted in the tech sector and expanding to support members from all walks of life. **Employees are eligible for:** * Traditional medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous 401(k) match * Paid Time Off: You'll accrue up to 15 days in your first year. In addition, you'll receive 40 hours of sick time and 3 personal days, which refresh annually * Paid federal holidays * Special employee pricing on lending products such as mortgage, auto, and personal loans (eligibility subject to standard account requirements and underwriting criteria) **Employment Statements:** First Tech is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity, inclusion, and equity at our company. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. *If you're applying for a job and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an email to recruiters@firsttechfed.com and let us know the nature of your request and contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.* ***First Tech is not currently offering Visa transfer/sponsorship for this position.***
