jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Email Editing, Fullstack
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Email Editing team owns the creative heart of Mailchimp: the editors millions of customers use to design, personalize, and publish email campaigns that reach hundreds of millions of inboxes. Our work spans the full stack, and then some: * A **modern, interactive email editor** — a rich React \+ TypeScript editing experience where customers visually compose, style, and preview their campaigns. * **Backend services** that validate content, apply brand styling, generate previews, and render customer designs into HTML that displays correctly across notoriously inconsistent email clients. * A **large\-scale web application** serving millions of users, where we modernize long\-lived product surfaces while keeping them reliable for the customers who depend on them every day. * **AI\-powered editing** — services that let customers edit their emails in natural language: "make the header blue and add a Summer Sale banner." "Fullstack" is not a buzzword here. In a given quarter you might evolve how email content is structured and stored, optimize the rendering pipeline, ship a new editing interaction in the visual canvas, and improve how our AI features manipulate customer designs — all in service of one editing experience. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate features **end\-to\-end across the stack**: a rich frontend editing experience, backend content and rendering services, and AI\-powered capabilities. * Help set technical direction for how **customer email content is structured, validated, and versioned** — and evolve those formats without breaking millions of customers' saved campaigns and templates. * Own **rendering correctness**: turn customer designs into email HTML that renders reliably across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and the long tail of email clients, while meeting performance and accessibility standards. * Shape our **AI editing capabilities**: design the interfaces between AI\-driven edits and customer content, and hold AI\-produced changes to the same quality bar as human\-authored ones. * Lead workstreams that **modernize legacy technology** — migrating customers and their saved content safely to newer experiences, shipped incrementally with controlled rollouts. * **Operate what you ship**: instrument services with logging, metrics, and tracing; participate in on\-call; and use observability data to keep quality high in production. * Build for **scale, accessibility, and compliance**: millions of users, WCAG accessibility standards, and awareness of email regulations such as GDPR and CAN\-SPAM. * **Multiply the team**: mentor engineers, write clear design documents, raise the bar in code review, and collaborate closely with design, product management, and partner teams across Mailchimp and Intuit. * Champion **responsible AI\-assisted development** — use modern AI tooling to move faster while establishing the practices that keep generated code reviewable and trustworthy. **Qualifications** ### **Required** * 8\+ years of professional software development experience (or equivalent demonstrated ability), including several years building and shipping production web applications at scale. * Hands\-on experience building **LLM\-powered product features**: working with agent frameworks, designing tools for AI systems, prompt design, or evaluation pipelines. * Deep expertise in **TypeScript/JavaScript and React**, including experience building complex, state\-heavy user interfaces (editors, canvases, design tools, or comparably interactive products). * Strong server\-side engineering experience in **at least one of Node.js, PHP, or Python** — and genuine willingness to work across more than one, since our stack spans several. * Experience **designing, operating, and debugging production APIs and services**, including instrumentation, monitoring, and incident response. * A track record of **staff\-level technical leadership**: driving initiatives that span multiple engineers or teams, decomposing large or ambiguous problems, and mentoring others. * Strong **testing discipline** across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels, and habits that keep large, long\-lived codebases healthy. * Excellent **written and verbal communication**, suited to a distributed team where design docs and async collaboration carry real weight. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, **or equivalent practical experience** — we care about what you can do, not the path you took to learn it. ### **Nice to have — none of these are required** * Experience with **HTML email rendering** and its constraints (email client quirks, templating frameworks, deliverability considerations). * Experience building **editors or document tooling**: rich\-text or visual editors, schema\-driven UIs, undo/redo systems, or collaborative editing. * Experience leading **legacy modernization** — incrementally replacing older frameworks or architectures in a system that must stay reliable throughout. * Familiarity with **high\-scale data and infrastructure**: large relational databases, caching, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines. * Depth in **web accessibility** (WCAG) beyond the basics. * Familiarity with **email and privacy regulations** (GDPR, CAN\-SPAM). jobs.title: Designer (Fire Sprinkler)
jobs.description: Job Description: **ABOUT IRONSMITH FIRE, LLC** Our mission is to empower elite teams to deliver solutions, uphold high standards, and achieve outstanding results. We work with general contractors, business owners, property developers, engineers, and many other types of clients to provide life\-saving fire protection systems. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide everything we do, including the hiring process. These core values are Workmanship, Accountability, and Results. Ironsmith Fire, LLC is privately owned and growing by the day. **POSITION SUMMARY** A fire sprinkler Designer is responsible for creating detailed plans and specifications for the installation of automatic fire sprinkler systems in various types of buildings, such as residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional structures. The Designer reports to the Design Manager. **OBJECTIVES** * Embrace the Ironsmith Fire slogan of “OLD SCHOOL GRIT, NEW AGE EDGE”. This includes having that old school work ethic, while embracing new technologies and devices that drive innovation and job optimization. * Assessing building blueprints and specifications to determine the most effective placement and type of sprinkler system required. * Calculating water flow and pressure requirements based on building size, occupancy type, and fire hazards. * Selecting appropriate sprinkler heads, pipes, valves, and other components to meet building code and safety standards. * Creating detailed drawings and schematics that illustrate the layout of the sprinkler system, including pipe routing, location of sprinkler heads, and connection points. Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, and local authorities to ensure compliance with building codes, regulations, and industry standards. * Prepare shop drawings that are complete and ACCURATE. * Prepare and submit closeout documents as required by the project. * Prepare detailed stocklist for purchasing to order the materials needed for the job. * Collaborate with fabrication teams to ensure the correct material is making it to the field. * Complete submittal packages prepared and delivered to the Authority Having Jurisdiction, customers, and any other required entities for that project. * Coordinate with other trades to ensure our installation goes as smoothly as possible, helping our field teams to avoid conflicts on the jobsite. This includes BIM coordination on projects where it is required. * Thorough analysis of construction documents, including plans and specifications, to ensure we deliver the product our customers expect. * Be disciplined in utilizing design checklists to ensure required information is on the project documents. * Present yourself professionally, and attend project meetings leading up to the start of construction, and as required after construction has begun. * Must submit and release at set deadlines to ensure our team stays on schedule as the project progresses. The designer’s punctuality and attention to project schedule is crucial for the success of our field team getting to start the job on time. You must be results\-driven and carry a sense of urgency of achieving those results. * Providing technical support and guidance during the installation, testing, and commissioning of the sprinkler system. * Conducting site visits and inspections to verify that the installed system meets design specifications and regulatory requirements. * Work closely with the Design Manager to analyze metrics and KPI’s associated with this position to assess progress towards goals and identify areas for improvement. **Job Requirements:** **COMPETENCIES** * Comprehensive understanding of fire protection systems, building codes, local regulations, and industry standards. * Ability to perform complex calculations to determine water flow, pressure, and pipe sizing requirements for fire sprinkler systems. * Meticulous attention to detail is necessary to ensure accuracy in calculations, drawings, and specifications. * Effective communication skills. * Ability to stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments to adapt sales strategies. * Aptitude for identifying and resolving issues that may arise during the design process or project installation. * Technologically proficient with AutoCAD, Revit, Hydraulic Calculation software, and Microsoft Office Suite. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Associate’s degree in business administration, engineering technology, or a closely related field is preferred, but not required. * Minimum of 2\-years in fire sprinkler design or NICET Level II * Comprehensive understanding of the fire protection industry and applicable regulations. * Professional certifications related to fire protection, business management, or leadership are advantageous, such as NICET Certification. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * The ability to maintain a high level of energy and stamina to manage long hours, travel requirements, and the stress associated with high\-level decision making. * The ability to travel, sometimes extensively, to meet with clients in different locations. * While primarily a skill, the physical aspect includes the ability to speak clearly and effectively in public and private settings, and to engage in face\-to\-face meetings. * Good general health to fulfill job responsibilities effectively, including being able to work long hours when necessary.

jobs.title: Lead Fire Alarm Technician
jobs.description: Job Description: ABOUT IRONSMITH FIRE, LLC Our mission is to empower elite teams to deliver solutions, uphold high standards, and achieve outstanding results. We work with general contractors, business owners, property developers, engineers, and many other types of clients to provide life\-saving fire protection systems. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide everything we do, including the hiring process. These core values are Workmanship, Accountability, and Results. Ironsmith Fire, LLC is privately owned and growing by the day. POSITION SUMMARY The Lead Fire Alarm Technician is responsible for directing and performing the installation, programming, inspection, and maintenance of fire alarm systems. This role ensures all systems are installed accurately, function safely, and operate as designed while meeting all applicable codes, regulations, and industry standards. The Lead Technician provides oversight and guidance to team members, troubleshoots system issues, and verifies compliance through thorough testing and evaluation to ensure optimal performance and life safety protection. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / OBJECTIVES * Ensure fire alarm systems are installed, programmed, inspected, and serviced to meet all applicable codes, standards, and safety requirements. * Lead and support all phases of fire alarm work, including installation, inspection, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance. * Drive system reliability and performance by identifying issues, implementing corrective actions, and verifying proper system operation. * Oversee project execution to ensure work is completed on time, within scope, and to quality expectations. * Maintain a high level of compliance with local, state, and national fire and life safety regulations. * Provide leadership and guidance to technicians, fostering strong team performance, accountability, and skill development. * Deliver excellent customer service by communicating clearly, resolving issues efficiently, and ensuring client satisfaction. * Demonstrate flexibility and a hands\-on approach by actively participating in all aspects of fire alarm work as needed. * Continuously evaluate processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, safety, and service quality. **Job Requirements:** COMPETENCIES * Clearly and effectively communicates with team members, project managers, and customers to ensure alignment on project scope, timelines, and system performance expectations. * Takes ownership of work quality and outcomes, ensuring fire alarm systems are completed correctly the first time and meet all required codes and standards. * Leads by example in the field, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to technicians to drive productivity, skill development, and overall team performance. * Demonstrates strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities to quickly identify issues and implement effective solutions to maintain system reliability. * Maintains a high standard of conduct, reliability, and attention to detail in all interactions and work performed, representing the company positively. * Proficient in installing, programming, inspecting, and troubleshooting fire alarm systems, ensuring systems function reliably and in compliance with all applicable codes. * Prioritizes accuracy and adherence to regulations to ensure work is completed right the first time, minimizing rework and maintaining safety standards. * Manages time and resources effectively to complete projects on schedule and within budget while maintaining quality expectations. * Actively contributes to building a productive, high\-performing team by coaching technicians and encouraging continuous improvement. * Committed to delivering positive customer outcomes, ensuring satisfaction through dependable system performance and responsive service. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE * High School Diploma or equivalent required. * Minimum of 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in fire alarm system installation, programming, inspection, and service. * NICET certifications are preferred. * Must hold or be able to obtain a Fire Alarm License in Tennessee (TN), Arkansas (AR), and Mississippi (MS) within the required timeframe. * Ability to successfully pass state\-required background checks, including TBI and FBI screenings. * Fire alarm system installation, programming, and configuration * Troubleshooting and diagnostic expertise * Strong electrical knowledge * Ability to read and interpret blueprints and riser diagrams * Comprehensive understanding of fire alarm codes and compliance requirements * Leadership and team management capabilities * Strong project management and organizational skills * Effective verbal and written communication skills * Problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities * Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods of time throughout the workday. * Capable of working at heights of 6 feet or higher, including ladders and elevated platforms. * Must be able to lift, carry, and move materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Comfortable working in both indoor and outdoor environments under varying weather conditions. * Ability to work in loud environments and around active construction or operational sites. * Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed to support project and service requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer (AI, Office of the CEO)
jobs.description: **Do you want to be the first engineer on something an entire company will run on?** Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a **Principal Software Engineer, AI,** to join the **Office of the CEO**. **The team:** This is a startup inside Jobber. A small, senior team in the Office of the CEO with a mandate to reinvent how a 1,000\-person company operates in the AI era, and the backing to actually do it. No layers between you and the decision\-makers, no roadmap theater, no waiting for alignment. We ship something real every few hours, learn from it, and compound. The work touches every function at Jobber, and what we build becomes how the company thinks and moves. **The role:** Reporting to the **VP of Customer Experience Innovation**, the Principal Software Engineer will be the founding technical seat: you'll architect and build new AI systems from zero to production, and own the hard problems that come with putting AI at the center of how a company runs — trust, permissions, security, and quality at scale. This is a builder's role with unusual range. One week you're designing the architecture of a system nobody at Jobber has built before; the next you're embedded with a team, shipping working AI into their real workflow and making them the hero. You'll make fast build\-vs\-buy calls, run POCs and kill them without sentiment, and set the technical standards that everything AI at Jobber gets held to. We're looking for someone who has shipped production AI or data systems, defaults to pragmatic technology choices, and wants founding\-engineer ownership with a real company's resources behind it. The **Principal Software Engineer, AI** will: * Architect and build new internal AI systems end to end, from first design to production, as the founding engineer. * Own the hard parts of trustworthy AI at company scale: retrieval quality, permissions, security, and reliability. * Work hands\-on across the modern AI stack (LLMs, retrieval, agents, integrations) while keeping the foundations deliberately pragmatic. * Embed with teams across the company, working day\-to\-day with function leaders and their teams and weekly with executive leadership, shipping AI into real workflows and leaving behind systems and owners that outlast the visit. * Drive build\-vs\-buy evaluations and fast POCs, with the judgment to commit hard and kill fast. * Work directly with executive leadership: what you build informs how the company makes decisions, every day. **To be successful, you should have:** * A track record of building production systems at Staff\+ scope: data infrastructure, retrieval, or applied AI used daily by hundreds to thousands of people who depend on it. * Hands\-on depth with the modern AI stack, and at least one battle scar from a system that showed you how confidently AI can be wrong. * Pragmatic technology instincts: you reach for proven tools by default and can defend the exceptions. * Founding\-engineer, consulting, or forward\-deployed experience: comfortable owning outcomes inside someone else's domain. * A daily working relationship with AI tools and agents, as instruments you build with and build for. * The pragmatism to ship every few weeks, the standards to make it trustworthy anyway, and the communication skills to explain both to a CEO. **Compensation:** At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $229,300, a midpoint of $269,700, and a maximum salary of $310,200, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long\-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process! **What you can expect from Jobber:** * A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. * A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. * A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400\-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. * To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh\*t about our customers. *We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Join a team where you can grow through meaningful work, learning opportunities, and a culture that values your voice, collaboration, and customer impact. **Role Overview** ----------------- As an Account Executive Security \& Fire, you will sell Johnson Controls security and integrated systems offerings to building owners, primarily at the Director level, while building long\-term relationships with target and managed accounts. This role is focused on consultative selling in the construction environment, with responsibility for identifying opportunities, advancing specifications, and closing business on a monthly basis. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build and maintain partnering relationships with assigned accounts to grow penetration of Security and Integrated Systems and Services offerings. * Engage frequently with customers who influence buying decisions, actively listen to their needs, and address concerns with credibility and professionalism. * Work with contractors to prepare take\-offs and bids across the full spectrum of Johnson Controls offerings. * Partner with consulting engineers to drive project specifications toward the Johnson Controls solution set. * Develop favorable specifications with owner accounts and expand the depth and breadth of Johnson Controls within each account. * Manage the sales process from qualification through close, seeking and closing new opportunities on a monthly basis. * Keep management informed of account status, progress, and support needs throughout the sales cycle. * Demonstrate technical knowledge by aligning proposals and specifications with building requirements to create value for the customer. * Qualify and assess prospects under direction, collaborate with colleagues on assigned projects, and refer opportunities to other business segments when appropriate. * Build strong working relationships with internal operations and administrative teams to support customer satisfaction and timely issue resolution. **How You Will Do It** ---------------------- * You will build trusted relationships by staying close to the work, speaking the customer's language, and focusing on what matters most to their business. * You will own your commitments with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping the sales process moving. * You will use curiosity and candor to uncover customer concerns early, then turn them into clear next steps and solutions. * You will collaborate with contractors, consulting engineers, owners, and internal teams as one Johnson Controls team. * You will improve every day by learning from each pursuit, refining your approach, and strengthening your technical and commercial expertise. * You will position Johnson Controls thoughtfully and professionally through strong specifications, value\-based proposals, and disciplined follow\-through. **Qualifications** ------------------ * More than eight years of degree or equivalent experience. * At least two years of consultative, progressive field sales experience in a highly complex sales process, preferably in the Fire, Security, or IT industry, with a strong emphasis on Security selling. * Excellent initiative and interpersonal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence the market at key levels. * Technical aptitude and comfort discussing solutions with building owners, contractors, and engineers. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in business or Engineering. * Five or more years of proven sales success in the Fire, Security, or IT industry. * Experience selling security, fire, or integrated building systems in a construction or consultative sales environment. **Why Join Us** --------------- Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and commission, paid vacation, holidays, and sick time, with 15 days of vacation in the first year. You will also have access to a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k), medical, dental, and vision coverage available day one. Additional highlights include a collaborative team environment, dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy, a company vehicle, and a competitive Sales Incentive Plan tied to project, quarterly, and annual margin. If you are ready to grow your career while helping customers protect and connect their buildings, we encourage you to apply. Salary Range: HIRING SALARY RANGE: $69,000 to $107,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role also offers a competitive Sales Incentive Plan that will take into account volume and margin on a project, quarterly, and annual basis. This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about\-us

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Karman is a fast\-growing NVIDIA\-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real\-time visibility and power\-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them. We are seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to develop production\-grade firmware for power grid edge computing platforms. You will work alongside a diverse team of experts across hardware, cloud infrastructure, and AI/algorithms to design, implement, and deploy embedded systems running on mission\-critical power infrastructure. This role focuses on hands\-on development across multiple hardware variants — writing firmware features, extending our CI/CD and test infrastructure, building logging and diagnostic tooling, and supporting hardware bring\-up under the guidance of senior engineers. We are looking for an early\-career engineer who is eager to learn from experienced mentors to develop production\-grade firmware. **Responsibilities*** Develop, test, and deploy firmware features across multiple hardware platforms, contributing scalable and fault\-tolerant components * Assist with hardware bring\-up efforts and collaborate directly with hardware engineering teams during development cycles * Write and debug real\-time embedded software in C/C\+\+ on resource\-constrained microcontrollers, using the RTOS and bare\-metal patterns established by the team * Implement and debug communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, LTE, WiFi) for IoT device connectivity * Uphold firmware engineering standards, including coding conventions, testing protocols, and documentation requirements * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, HIL (hardware\-in\-the\-loop) test infrastructure, and automated release tooling using Python, Docker, and GitHub Actions * Extend logging, telemetry, and diagnostic subsystems, including dissectors and lab tooling * Collaborate cross\-functionally with external contractors, cloud infrastructure, AI/algorithms, and product teams to deliver integrated solutions **Minimum Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 0–3 years of embedded firmware experience, including internships, coursework projects, capstone work, or a first full\-time role * Working proficiency in C (and ideally C\+\+) with exposure to RTOS or bare\-metal programming on a microcontroller * Familiarity with common embedded interfaces — at least two of SPI, I2C, UART, or Ethernet * Hands\-on experience with hardware — bench work, board bring\-up, personal projects, or hardware\-adjacent internships * Comfort with debugging tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or JTAG debuggers * Working knowledge of Git and exposure to a CI/CD system (GitHub Actions or similar) * Python scripting comfort for test harnesses, build tooling, or automation * Strong written and verbal communication, and a collaborative work style with cross\-functional teams * Curiosity, willingness to ask clarifying questions, and eagerness to learn from senior engineers **Enhanced Qualifications (Nice to Have)*** Experience or coursework involving FPGA development * Any STM32 development experience or Cortex\-M33\-class parts (e.g., STM32H5\) * Docker experience for reproducible build environments * Experience writing hardware\-in\-the\-loop or bench\-automation tests * Exposure to embedded security fundamentals * Wireshark, protocol analysis, or Lua dissector experience * Static analysis or code\-formatting tooling exposure (clang\-format, clang\-tidy, cppcheck, or similar) * Rust or other modern systems\-programming language exposure * Personal or academic projects involving robotics, PCB design, or embedded work * Interest in the physics, mathematics, and hardware components which underlie the U.S. electricity grid and evolving power systems * Familiarity with linux systems (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, AMD/XILINX Kria) * Familiarity with Agile development methodologies **Salary Range:** $120,000 to $160,000 base compensation depending on experience plus stock options. Salary will be commensurate with an individual's skills, training, years of experience, and in line with internal compensation bands. **Location:** This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States, preference will be given to candidates based in Michigan with the ability to work on site in Utilidata’s headquarters. **Our Commitments:** Karman values the diversity of our team. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or childbirth, sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, or status as a covered veteran or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. We are committed to:* Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is welcoming, supportive, affirming and respectful * Empowering employees to solve problems and work together to make a difference * Providing mentorship and growth opportunities as part of a collaborative team * A flexible work environment with flexible paid time off * Competitive compensation and benefits, including health, dental, vision, and employer\-match 401k ZATv9CJjd9

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (semiconductor/capital equipment)
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost\-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead the Diagnostics \& Calibration software team for EUV actinic reticle inspection system. This role will be responsible for technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution for software that diagnoses and calibrates KLA’s reticle inspection platforms. We are looking for a leader who is energized by problems that are one of a kind and is not afraid to push the limits of creativity. If you are someone who will leverage the current wave of AI and motivate the team to spin up a proof\-of\-concept over a weekend because you are curious this role is for you. You will partner closely with physicists, hardware engineers, system teams, and global software organizations to translate complex system\-level requirements into robust, scalable diagnostic and calibration solutions. This is a hands\-on leadership role ideal for a manager who enjoys growing teams while remaining technically engaged. * Lead, and grow a high\-performing Diagnostics \& Calibration software team. * Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight for multi\-language software systems. * Learn and understand existing diagnostics and calibration software architecture, and guide development to meet program goals. * Lead exploration and application of AI/ML and generative\-AI techniques — LLMs, agents, and automation — to build applications and internal tools that improve diagnostics, calibration, developer productivity, and data analysis. * Translate system\-level and user requirements into clear technical direction, software design, and execution plans. * Drive design excellence to improve software reliability, maintainability, performance, and scalability. * Partner cross\-functionally with hardware, subsystem, system, manufacturing, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions. * Lead design reviews, code reviews, and development best practices across the team. * Own delivery commitments including planning, execution tracking, and risk management. * Experience and familiarity with industry standard CI/CD pipelines and workflows to support reliable and efficient release of software. * Support root\-cause analysis of complex system\-level issues and guide the team toward effective, sustainable solutions. Travel occasionally to global sites and customer locations to support integration, bring\-up, and deployment activities (10–20%). **Minimum Qualifications** * Multidisciplinary background in either Physical science, Computer science, Microscopy, Optics, or relevant fields with either a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in relevant field. * 8\+ years of software development experience, with 2\+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role. * Strong background in system\-level software development involving hardware\-software interaction. * Familiarity with using AI tools for SW development (e.g. Devin, Codex) * Familiarity with building applications using LLMs / generative AI and agentic frameworks, and integrate them into engineering workflows. * Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps) * Proficiency programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, or C\#. * Experience developing medium to large\-scale software applications in multi\-developer environments. * Demonstrated ability to translate user needs and system requirements into technical specifications and executable plans. * Strong problem\-solving skills with experience diagnosing and resolving complex system\-level issues. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills in globally distributed teams. * Self\-motivated leader with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. **Preferred but not required** * Experience in diagnostics, calibration, machine control, inspection, or metrology systems. * Familiarity with computer vision, image processing, or image analysis techniques. * Proficiency in LabVIEW (object\-oriented design preferred) * Hands\-on experience in semi\-capital equipment (semi\-CAPEX) product environments. **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. jobs.title: AI Operations Lead
jobs.description: **About Karbon** Karbon is the global leader in AI\-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award\-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well\-funded, ranked \#1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people\-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List. Karbon is further ahead on AI adoption than most companies our size. Every department is running AI daily. Hundreds of skills and workflows have been built by our own team. Fourteen department champions drive adoption and share knowledge across the business. The foundation is real and it works. The next phase is scale. We need one person whose entire job is extending what we have built, measuring what it returns, and adding the next layer of capability. Not a strategy deck. A working system, the governance that makes it trustworthy, and the numbers that prove it. You will report into the CEO and work across every department. You will have the access and sponsorship to make changes stick. #### **About the Role** #### **Build the Tooling** * Ship internal automations and agents that remove repeated manual work across Sales, CS, Implementation, Support, and Operations. Connect AI to the systems we already run, through APIs and MCP servers. * The first build is the data gateway. Karbon runs its own MCP server. You extend it into a routing proxy that sits between Claude and every internal data source teams need. Authentication via Okta. RBAC enforcement by department. Request logging for spend attribution and audit. Once the gateway is approved by Security, new connectors plug into a config entry instead of triggering a full review each time. That is your first thirty days. * After that: CS gets a renewal risk signal. Sales gets a proposal draft automation. Implementation gets a SOW generator with scope\-creep flags. Support gets a ticket triage router. * Prototype fast. Harden what people use. Delete what they ignore. Hand every tool to an owner in the team that uses it. You build it. They run it. #### **Own Governance and Visibility** * Manage the Claude access and provisioning workflow — seat requests, model and tool access, connector approvals — and the Slack workflows that support it. Run the connector security review pipeline in partnership with Security. * Own the spend dashboard across all AI tools, not just Claude. Cursor, Codex, Linear AI, and anything else the org is running sit alongside Claude in one view. Department leaders see their own number weekly without asking you to pull it. Bad trends surface before they become invoice surprises. * Extend that visibility into an ROI framework: adoption rate, hours saved, cost per seat, project\-level impact. Partner with Finance on budget accountability. * Run the AI champions program. Fourteen department champions, organized into pods, own peer enablement and skill submissions within their teams. You run the cadences, maintain the hub pages, and hold champions accountable for engagement. When people leave Karbon, their projects and skills do not leave with them. You own the offboarding flow that captures and reassigns that work. * Build and maintain the AI wiki — per\-department documentation of tools, active use cases, and skills in use. Keep it current as tools evolve. #### **Train Teams and Set the Standard** * Work with each department lead to agree how their team uses AI, then hold that standard. * Run practical training. Short, specific, and repeatable. Teach people the efficient way to get the same answer. Most cost problems are habit problems. After month one, you know what each team's workflows look like because you built them. That makes you a better trainer than anyone who has not. * Build and maintain a shared library of prompts, skills, and patterns so knowledge stays when a person leaves. Own the pipeline that moves skills from intake through review to the shared library — and automate the parts of it that should not require a human. #### **Measure and Report the Return** * Define the small set of metrics that show whether AI is working: cost, adoption, delivery, and quality. * Build the data pipelines behind those metrics. Expect the source data to be messy. Publish a regular report to the executive team. Same format every time. Bad news included. * Delete any metric that has not changed a decision in a quarter. #### **About You!** * You shipped production software in the last two years, as the person writing the code. Python or TypeScript, SQL, and REST APIs. * You built something real on top of a large language model. Not a demo. Something with users, error handling, and a cost you had to control. * You worked directly with non\-technical teams as the technical person in the room. Forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, GTM engineer, internal tools engineer, or similar. You know what a CS renewal motion looks like and what implementation scoping feels like. You do not need to have worked in those roles. You need to have built something those teams actually used. * You can build a number out of messy data and defend it to a CFO. * You have run a cross\-functional program where the participants did not report to you — a champion network, an ambassador program, an adoption initiative. You know how to create accountability without authority. * You write clearly, and you can say no to work that will not pay off. **Bonus Points:** Accounting, professional services, or B2B software market experience. Familiarity with MCP server development, Claude API, or agent frameworks. Experience with Okta or similar identity providers. #### **What Success Looks Like!** **By month six:** Three automations run in production, each owned by the team that uses it. Every department leader can see their own AI usage and cost, including spend outside Claude. The spend dashboard is live and trusted. Your first report to the executive team is argued with, not just acknowledged. The gateway has Security sign\-off and every new connector goes through it. **By month twelve:** Cost per unit of work delivered is moving in the right direction, and everyone agrees on how it is calculated. Three departments extend and run their own tools without you. New starters learn our way of working with AI as part of onboarding. Champion pods are submitting and reviewing skills without you in the loop. The AI wiki is maintained by department owners, not by you. #### **Why Work at Karbon?** * Gain global experience across Australia, New Zealand, UK, and Canada * Strong benefits package including: * + Flexible Time Off with an encouraged 4 weeks use per year + Company paid medical for you and eligible spouse/partner and dependents + Paid dental and vision and eligible spouse/partner and dependents + 401(k) with company matching + Flexible Spending Account + Up to 8 weeks paid parental leave + Work\-from\-home stipend * Work with (and learn from) an experienced, high\-performing team * A collaborative, team\-oriented culture that embraces diversity, invests in development and provides consistent feedback * Be part of a fast\-growing company that firmly believes in promoting high performers from within **Please be aware that Karbon will only contact you via email from our domain, karbonhq.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links.** Karbon embraces diversity and inclusion, aligning with our values as a business. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single criteria. If you've made it this far in the job description but your past experience doesn't perfectly align, we do encourage you to still apply. You could still be the right person for the role! We recruit and reward people based on capability and performance. We don't discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lifestyle, age, educational background, national origin, religion, physical or cognitive ability, and other diversity dimensions that may hinder inclusion in the organization. Generally, if you are a good person, we want to talk to you. If there are any adjustments or accommodations that we can make to assist you during the recruitment process, and your journey at Karbon, contact us at people.support@karbonhq.com for a confidential discussion. ***At this time, we request that agency referrals are not submitted for this position. We appreciate your understanding and encourage direct applications from interested candidates. Thank you!***

jobs.title: AI Operations Lead
jobs.description: **About Karbon** Karbon is the global leader in AI\-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award\-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well\-funded, ranked \#1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people\-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List. Karbon is further ahead on AI adoption than most companies our size. Every department is running AI daily. Hundreds of skills and workflows have been built by our own team. Fourteen department champions drive adoption and share knowledge across the business. The foundation is real and it works. The next phase is scale. We need one person whose entire job is extending what we have built, measuring what it returns, and adding the next layer of capability. Not a strategy deck. A working system, the governance that makes it trustworthy, and the numbers that prove it. You will report into the CEO and work across every department. You will have the access and sponsorship to make changes stick. #### **About the Role** #### **Build the Tooling** * Ship internal automations and agents that remove repeated manual work across Sales, CS, Implementation, Support, and Operations. Connect AI to the systems we already run, through APIs and MCP servers. * The first build is the data gateway. Karbon runs its own MCP server. You extend it into a routing proxy that sits between Claude and every internal data source teams need. Authentication via Okta. RBAC enforcement by department. Request logging for spend attribution and audit. Once the gateway is approved by Security, new connectors plug into a config entry instead of triggering a full review each time. That is your first thirty days. * After that: CS gets a renewal risk signal. Sales gets a proposal draft automation. Implementation gets a SOW generator with scope\-creep flags. Support gets a ticket triage router. * Prototype fast. Harden what people use. Delete what they ignore. Hand every tool to an owner in the team that uses it. You build it. They run it. #### **Own Governance and Visibility** * Manage the Claude access and provisioning workflow — seat requests, model and tool access, connector approvals — and the Slack workflows that support it. Run the connector security review pipeline in partnership with Security. * Own the spend dashboard across all AI tools, not just Claude. Cursor, Codex, Linear AI, and anything else the org is running sit alongside Claude in one view. Department leaders see their own number weekly without asking you to pull it. Bad trends surface before they become invoice surprises. * Extend that visibility into an ROI framework: adoption rate, hours saved, cost per seat, project\-level impact. Partner with Finance on budget accountability. * Run the AI champions program. Fourteen department champions, organized into pods, own peer enablement and skill submissions within their teams. You run the cadences, maintain the hub pages, and hold champions accountable for engagement. When people leave Karbon, their projects and skills do not leave with them. You own the offboarding flow that captures and reassigns that work. * Build and maintain the AI wiki — per\-department documentation of tools, active use cases, and skills in use. Keep it current as tools evolve. #### **Train Teams and Set the Standard** * Work with each department lead to agree how their team uses AI, then hold that standard. * Run practical training. Short, specific, and repeatable. Teach people the efficient way to get the same answer. Most cost problems are habit problems. After month one, you know what each team's workflows look like because you built them. That makes you a better trainer than anyone who has not. * Build and maintain a shared library of prompts, skills, and patterns so knowledge stays when a person leaves. Own the pipeline that moves skills from intake through review to the shared library — and automate the parts of it that should not require a human. #### **Measure and Report the Return** * Define the small set of metrics that show whether AI is working: cost, adoption, delivery, and quality. * Build the data pipelines behind those metrics. Bad news included. * Delete any metric that has not changed a decision in a quarter. #### **About You!** * You shipped production software in the last two years, as the person writing the code. jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 182518 **Job Level:** Entry Level **Home District/Group:** Kiewit Infrastructure Engineers **Department:** Drafting \& Design **Market:** Transportation Employment Type: Full Time **Position Overview** --------------------- Kiewit Infrastructure Engineers (KIE) is seeking an early career Civil/Structural CAD Designer in our Engineering Services During Construction (ESDC) Production group in the KIE Omaha, NE office. On our team, you'll have the opportunity to see more, touch more, and do more than you ever imagined. Working hard will not only bring you satisfaction from a job well done, but it will help propel your career forward faster than you might expect. We will train you, develop your skills, and allow you to take on projects that impact millions across North America. With top\-notch health benefits, a wealth\-building 401k plan, and unbeatable growth opportunities, by joining Kiewit, you're ensuring a lifetime of success. **Location** ------------ This position is located in downtown Omaha, NE at our Kiewit Headquarters. This role requires regular, onsite attendance. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Work with our engineering teams and Clients to provide latest As\-Built design drawings to construction team * Virtual plan set support, with emphasis on training personnel on construction team * Coordinate with Document Control specialists to manage accurate redline/markup changes in virtual plan set * Review of client As\-Built/Record Drawing requirements and develop As\-Built/Record Drawing plan * Work with construction team and assisting them in documentation of redline/markup changes made in the field * Coordinate effective meetings with construction/client teams and track down answers * Participate in change documentation reviews to evaluate and make recommendations * Work with construction team to provide the Client with As\-Built/Record Drawing submittals **Qualifications** ------------------ * Associate degree or High School diploma \+ 2 years’ experience as a minimum. * 0\-2 years' minimum relevant experience. * Proficiency in Autodesk AutoCAD * Additional proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D, MicroStation, or Revit is a plus * Infrastructure project design or construction experience is a plus * General knowledge of engineering principles for civil / structural work * Read and understand civil / structural construction documents •Strong and Effective oral and written communication skills contributing to team\-based collaboration environment •Critical thinking skills necessary with the ability to plan and conceptualize * Capable of recognizing conflicts and discrepancies with strong attention to detail •Self\-motivation and drive to provide and excellent work product •Basic skills in Microsoft Office products (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint) * Travel expectation for this role is 10\-15% **Working Conditions** ---------------------- Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment. * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. * May work at various different locations and conditions may vary. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Entrepreneur-in-Residence, Digital Health (LG NOVA)
jobs.description: Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations. Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions. Our management philosophy, "Jeong\-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer\-Value Creation' and 'People\-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone. **LG Electronics North America Innovation Center ("LG NOVA")** LG Electronics established North America Innovation Center ("LG NOVA") in Santa Clara, California, USA., in the heart of Silicon Valley, with an ambitious vision to become the nerve center of global innovation. Aiming to create the future of LG with the focus on disruptive and exponential growth, LG NOVA works with global corporations, startups, governments, and technology stakeholders to create new businesses, establish strategic partnerships, and develop a broad ecosystem using the process of "outside\-in" innovation. **Position Summary** **Entrepreneur\-In\-Residence** We are currently seeking a Healthcare Entrepreneur\-in\-Residence to join LG NOVA's office in Santa Clara, CA. This is a contract position. The Healthcare Entrepreneur\-in\-Residence will play a critical role in unlocking the next chapter of transformational growth for this over $70 billion\-dollar global tech company. The goal of the innovation division is to identify and grow new healthcare businesses for the next chapter of LG in collaboration with other startups and partners. The EIR will be an integral part of our innovation team, focusing on identifying, developing, and launching new software\-driven healthcare tech ventures in collaboration with startup partners. This role is ideal for a seasoned or aspiring entrepreneur with a strong background in software development (engineering, product management, business development or other similar experience) and a passion for Healthtech. The EIR will work closely with our startup partners, engineers, and leadership team as well as universities/businesses to conceptualize and bring to market innovative software\-centric Healthtech solutions. **Roles and Responsibilities:** Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to: * Identify compelling digital health market opportunities and develop product and business concepts into new company spin outs * Collaborate with other start\-ups and partners to create more robust solutions, designed to better meet the customers need and accelerate time to market and time to scale * Partner with LG NOVA's Ecosystem team to source and evaluate potential start\-up partners * Conduct customer discovery and market validation to confirm job to be done and potential demand * Develop robust business plans including product strategy, business model and commercial plans. * Pitch to internal review committee and external investor partners to secure new company creation approval and funding * Develop financial projections that demonstrate the potential for the business to grow rapidly and achieve LG NOVA's ambitious goals * Develop networks of advisors and external experts that can assist in the development, validation and execution of a new business concept **Key Qualifications:** * Must have relevant experience in digital health, healthtech, and wellness markets * 5\+ years of experience in digital health product development, commercialization, and strategy * Experience in taking a product/company from 0\-1 in digital health is strongly preferred. Either as a founder or member of a founding team. * Experience working in a healthcare company in a product, strategy, or incubation/innovation role * BS in CS, Engineering, Science, or Business * Broad understanding of technology around AI, SaaS, cloud, platforms, and various business models such as recurring revenue models * Familiarity with venture financing mechanism and valuation models including new blended capital structures involving public/private funding and other impact related financial actors. * Experience with business and technical requirements analysis * Experience incubating new businesses at a startup and/or at a global tech company * Entrepreneurial mindset with bias for action in highly ambiguous environments – enjoys making sense of white space and exploring nascent opportunities with large potential * Critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, analytical/problem\-solving skills, and the ability to combine and balance qualitative analysis, strategy and operations * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and organizational skills * Fluency in English is a must **Why Join Us** * Opportunity to shape and lead new ventures from the ground up, supported by LG NOVA resources (business, technical and financial) from idea throughout the venture lifecycle with the dedicated funds we are in the process of creating. * Be at the forefront of healthcare tech innovation, working on solutions that have a real impact with a potential to reach $1B\+ valuation. * Collaborate with a talented and passionate team and LG NOVA Ecosystem Partners dedicated to driving change. * Competitive compensation **Engagement \& Venture Path** This Entrepreneur\-in\-Residence role is structured as a contract engagement, typically for an initial period of approximately 12 months. During this time, the EIR will work closely with LG NOVA to validate, build, and advance a new venture with the goal of developing it toward spinout. **Location:** this can be a hybrid position working out of our office in Santa Clara, CA. \#LI\-JH1 \#HYBRID **Benefits Offered Full\-Time Employees:** * No\-cost employee premiums for you and your eligible dependents for competitive medical, dental, vision and prescription benefits. * Auto enrollment with immediate vesting of competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options. * Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of paid sick and vacation time. * Performance based Short\-Term Incentives (varies by role). * Access to confidential mental health resources to help you and your loved ones improve your quality of life. Personal fitness goal incentives. * Family orientated benefits such as paid parental leave and support for families raising children with learning, social, behavioral challenges, or developmental disabilities. * Group Rate Life and Disability Insurance. **Benefits Offered Temporary/Contractors:** * Eligible for the relevant benefit programs offered through our partner agencies. Privacy Notice to California Applicants Applicants who need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact our team by phone at: 973\-477\-7090 or support@lg4me.freshdesk.com. This email and phone number will only reply to accommodation requests and is not intended for general employment inquiries. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. In addition to the above, LG believes that pay transparency is a key part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary ranges take into account many factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skillset, experience, licensure, certifications, internal equity, and other business needs. While we consider geographic pay differentials in final offers, because we operate in many geographies where applicable, the salary range listed may not reflect all geographic differentials applied*.*

jobs.description: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. **Lead Software Engineer** **Durham NC or Burlington NC** **Hybrid Schedule \-3 days in office, 2 days remote** **Monday\-Friday, 1st shift** **Job Responsibilities** * Provide hands\-on leadership on complex, multi\-team initiatives * Own end\-to\-end delivery for systems handling high\-volume transactions * Lead architecture and design decisions for distributed systems and event\-driven microservices * Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate new technologies * Establish and enforce engineering best practices * Mentor engineers and drive technical excellence **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree * 8 or more years of software engineering experience * 5 or more years of hands\-on Java development experience * 3 or more years of experience developing RESTful web services using the Spring framework * 3 or more years of experience with build tools such as Maven or Gradle * 3 or more years of experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit or Mockito * 3 or more years of experience with SQL development and database management * 3 or more years of experience leveraging Azure or AWS services for solution design and implementation **Preferred Qualifications** * 1 or more years of experience working in the healthcare domain, including knowledge of FHIR, HL7, and Azure Healthcare Services * 2 or jobs.title: Civil/ Environmental Engineer
jobs.description: Landau Associates is recognized for excellence in the environmental consulting industry. With nine offices in the Pacific Northwest and Gulf Coast, we have demonstrated that our focus on collaboration, responsiveness, and quality results in client satisfaction and long\-term relationships. As employees, we own the Company, and our ownership culture promotes individual accountability to our clients, each other, and our community. We are seeking a Civil/Environmental Engineering Project Manager to support our existing Permitting and Design practice area, including industrial stormwater and wastewater permit compliance support and treatment system design. This role offers a flexible hybrid work schedule in any one of the following office locations: **Seattle, Washington or Portland, Oregon**. **Key Responsibilities Include:** * Leading design and construction engineering tasks involving: * + Preparing written engineering reports to support facility construction and permitting. + Implementing the engineering requirements of environmental permits, including preparing and certifying permit applications, designing corrective actions, and certifying construction completion. + Designing site environmental infrastructure including utilities, drainage, industrial stormwater and wastewater treatment, landfill and other environmental barriers, and monitoring systems. + Preparing civil engineering plans and specifications to support environmental permitting, in coordination with other professional engineers. + Guiding construction observation and responding to contractor RFIs and change orders. * Managing key aspects of project delivery, including proposals, contracts, budgets, invoicing, and change management. * Coordinating with project teams, clients, and regulatory agencies and providing project administration support as needed. * Building and maintaining strong client relationships while identifying opportunities to support existing and prospective clients. * Training and mentoring junior staff to support these engineering tasks. **This position is available for the candidate who has:** * Bachelor's degree in civil, environmental, or chemical engineering. * 5 to 10\+ years of consulting experience in major job duties listed above. * Minimum 3\-5 years’ experience using Autodesk Civil 3D or similar software for engineering design. * PE license, or ability to obtain registration in WA and/or OR within 6 months of hire. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a collaborative project\-team environment, interchangeably supporting co\-workers and engaging co\-workers’ support to meet the specific needs of a wide range of projects. Landau Associates is committed to quality, collaboration, and responsiveness, and seeks candidates who share the same values. Landau Associates offers an excellent compensation and benefits package in an environment that promotes personal growth and professional advancement. The salary range for this position is $105,500 – $140,000\. Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including education, experience, performance, location, and internal equity. As part of our compensation program, we review and update our salary ranges at least annually. We provide a wide variety of benefits to support our employees and their families. Details can be found on the Careers page of our website. Qualified applicants please visit our Careers page at http://www.landauinc.com/careers/ to apply online. Landau Associates is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Site Development Coordinator
jobs.description: **About the Role** Lars Andersen \& Associates is seeking an organized, proactive Site Development Coordinator to guide commercial development projects from preliminary site review and due diligence through entitlement approval and design\-team handoff. This person will serve as the central point of coordination among the client, internal team, governmental agencies, and specialty consultants, keeping decisions, deliverables, risks, and deadlines moving across multiple projects. **Key Responsibilities** * Coordinate preliminary site feasibility and due diligence, including zoning and land\-use requirements, site access and circulation, utilities, drainage, floodplain and environmental constraints, title and survey matters, easements, development standards, and agency approval pathways. * Develop and maintain a project\-specific tracking schedule. Update it weekly to identify each task, responsible party, deadline, dependency, current status, critical\-path concern, and required client decision. * Lead multidisciplinary coordination with environmental and geotechnical consultants, traffic engineers, civil and structural engineers, surveyors, architects, landscape architects, electrical and utility consultants, fire and life\-safety consultants, and other specialists required by the jurisdiction or site. * Organize and conduct consultant and client meetings; prepare focused agendas, document decisions and action items, distribute meeting summaries, and follow through until assigned items are completed. * Research and confirm entitlement, permitting, public\-notice, and submittal requirements; coordinate pre\-application meetings and agency reviews; maintain complete records of correspondence, comments, approvals, and commitments. * Prepare and coordinate applications and supporting materials for site plan review, variances, conditional or special use permits, planned unit developments, rezoning, platting, design review, and other location\-specific approvals. * Attend governmental staff meetings, neighborhood meetings, planning commission and governing\-body hearings, and other public proceedings as required; coordinate presentation materials and consultant testimony. Travel is Required. * Review consultant scopes, proposals, schedules, and deliverables for completeness and alignment with project objectives; identify gaps, conflicts, long\-lead approvals, and emerging risks early and recommend practical next steps. * Provide concise ongoing project summaries and conduct twice\-monthly client status meetings covering progress, decisions, agency and consultant dependencies, upcoming deadlines, budget or scope concerns, and recovery plans for delayed items. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, urban planning, architecture, construction management, real estate development, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * Three or more years of commercial site development, due diligence, entitlement, civil engineering, planning, architecture, or development project coordination experience preferred. * Working knowledge of zoning, entitlements, site plans, plats, surveys, easements, utilities, access, drainage, and multidisciplinary design coordination; ability to read and interpret technical plans and agency comments. * Strong scheduling, organization, follow\-up, meeting facilitation, writing, and client\-service skills, with the judgment to manage multiple active projects and elevate risks promptly. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project\-tracking or scheduling software; willingness to travel for site visits, agency meetings, client meetings, and public hearings. Professional licensure is not required. **What We Offer** Competitive compensation and comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life\-insurance benefits; direct involvement in high\-impact commercial development projects; and a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth. Location: 101 and Olive Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and skill level Benefits: * Dental insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person
