jobs.title: System Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Join a team that is helping modernize the future of air traffic management while supporting one of the nation's most critical transportation missions. Leidos is seeking a Systems Integration Engineer to join the Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) program supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). In this role, you will be responsible for integrating, validating, and deploying mission\-critical capabilities that improve the safety, efficiency, and reliability of the National Airspace System (NAS). TFDM is the FAA's NextGen surface management solution that enhances airport surface and terminal airspace operations through an integrated traffic control and management system. As part of this team, you'll collaborate with software engineers, system engineers, and FAA stakeholders to deliver capabilities that directly support air traffic controllers and airport operations across the country. This position offers more than a traditional integration and test role. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with FAA customers during system deployments, formal test events, and customer acceptance activities at airports nationwide. You'll see your work transition from the lab into live operational environments while helping deliver technology that supports one of the world's most complex aviation systems. Location: This position is based in our **Egg Harbor, NJ** office with a hybrid schedule of three days per week in the office and two days working remotely. Travel: Up to 50% travel is required and is a key part of this role. You'll travel to FAA airport locations throughout the United States to support system integration, customer demonstrations, formal testing, and operational deployments. Working alongside FAA personnel in live airport environments provides a unique opportunity to gain firsthand operational experience, build strong customer relationships, and see the direct impact of your work as TFDM is deployed across the National Airspace System. Travel is typically one to two weeks per trip. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Primary Responsibilities As a member of a highly collaborative engineering team, you will: * Integrate, configure, and validate TFDM capabilities within both physical and virtual integration laboratories. * Execute system integration, verification, and validation activities to ensure the system is properly configured and operating within the National Airspace System. * Support formal customer demonstrations, verification events, and customer acceptance testing with FAA stakeholders. * Collaborate with software, systems engineering, networking, and infrastructure teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex system\-level issues. * Analyze integration and test results, identify root causes, and provide detailed technical documentation supporting issue resolution. * Support deployment and integration activities at FAA operational facilities, including Air Traffic Control Towers (ATCTs). * Execute system interface testing and validate communications across internal and external NAS interfaces. * Coordinate integration activities with FAA personnel and cross\-functional Leidos engineering teams. * Develop automated tools, scripts, and AI\-assisted solutions that improve testing efficiency, reduce manual effort, and streamline repetitive tasks. * Support remote deployment activities by coordinating with infrastructure, networking, and installation teams. * Learn and maintain a deep understanding of TFDM architecture, system functionality, interfaces, and operational workflows. * Partner with Systems Engineering to develop integration and test strategies for new capabilities and system enhancements. * Integrate services with databases, messaging systems, and external APIs. * Troubleshoot XML messaging, JMS queue configurations, networking issues, IP configurations, and interface connectivity. * Demonstrate system capabilities during formal "run\-for\-record" events supporting customer acceptance and release readiness. * Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior integration engineers while helping ensure program milestones are successfully achieved. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent experience may be considered. * Ability to obtain an FAA SF\-85P Public Trust. * Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, program leadership, and FAA customers. * Willingness to travel up to 50% to support customer deployments and operational testing. Preferred Qualifications * Experience integrating mission\-critical or highly available systems. * FAA or Air Traffic Management domain experience. * Knowledge of National Airspace System (NAS) interfaces including FDIO, STARS, TBFM, and ASDE\-X. * Experience leading formal integration, verification, or customer acceptance events. * Familiarity with Agile development methodologies including Scrum or Kanban. * Understanding of systems engineering processes including requirements management, interface definition, and verification. * Experience working with distributed systems, enterprise messaging, and service\-oriented architectures. ATMC If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. **Original Posting:** --------------------- September 25, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. **Pay Range:** -------------- Pay Range $87,100\.00 \- $157,450\.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. **About Leidos** Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. **Pay and Benefits** Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits. **Securing Your Data** Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. **Commitment to Non\-Discrimination** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***\*PLEASE NOTE: this position is located in Denver, CO or Seattle, WA and requires attendance in office up to three days a week.\**** ***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.*** #### **The Opportunity** LendingTree is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Insurance technology team and help build, enhance, and support web applications used by our customers and internal teams. You will contribute to new capabilities while also making thoughtful improvements within existing and greenfield codebases, including applications that integrate with third\-party services and databases. You will partner with teammates and the business to understand requirements, solve technical problems, and deliver reliable, maintainable software. Our team primarily works in C\#/.NET and modern web technologies, but we are open to engineers from other technical backgrounds who bring strong software engineering fundamentals, are eager to learn, and can ramp quickly. #### **How You'll Make an Impact** * Develop and enhance scalable, maintainable web applications that support LendingTree's Insurance business, including solutions that integrate with third\-party web services, databases, and user\-facing interfaces. * Support existing applications through troubleshooting, bug fixes, required upgrades, performance improvements, and changes to existing functionality. * Break down business and technical problems and contribute to solutions that are reliable, practical, and maintainable over time. * Translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into well\-designed technical solutions, and demonstrate completed features against agreed\-upon outcomes. * Contribute to strong engineering practices through code reviews, testing, documentation, design discussions, and continuous improvement of the development process. * Collaborate with teammates and business partners on shared initiatives, communicating technical ideas, questions, and tradeoffs clearly. #### **Who You'll Work With** You will be part of the technology team supporting LendingTree's Insurance business, working closely with other engineers and business partners to build and enhance applications that support our customers and internal teams. This is a collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to understand the business context behind the work, ask questions, share ideas, participate in code review and technical discussions, and learn from one another while delivering high\-quality software. #### **What You'll Bring** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting web applications. * Experience with a modern object\-oriented programming language and web development framework. Our team primarily uses C\# and .NET/ASP.NET, but experience with comparable technologies is welcome if you have strong fundamentals and can ramp quickly. * Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue, or demonstrated ability to learn new frameworks quickly. * Experience building business applications using relational databases such as SQL Server and familiarity with database design and data access patterns; exposure to NoSQL databases is helpful. * Experience building and integrating with service\-oriented and event\-driven systems, including APIs and third\-party integrations. * Understanding of software engineering best practices, including maintainable design, SOLID principles, design patterns, code review, and unit testing. * Experience working in an Agile development environment and delivering work against defined requirements and acceptance criteria. * Exposure to AI technologies and tools, with an understanding of how AI can be applied to support technical processes, workflows, and business outcomes. * Ability to understand business logic and project requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. #### **What Will Help You Thrive** * You are curious and willing to learn new languages, frameworks, technologies, and business domains rather than being tied to one specific stack. * You are comfortable working in an established codebase and can make thoughtful changes while balancing quality, maintainability, and risk. * You care about code quality and view code review and feedback as tools for learning, improving the product, and making the team stronger. * You enjoy collaborating with other developers, sharing what you know, asking questions, and learning from others. * You are willing to question assumptions constructively and voice your point of view when you see an opportunity to improve the work. * Exposure to cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is helpful. Azure experience, including provisioning, monitoring, performance management, or Application Insights, is a plus. * Knowledge of current web development practices using HTML5, CSS, and TypeScript is helpful. #### **What Success Looks Like** * You build a strong understanding of the Insurance applications, integrations, and business processes you support and become a dependable contributor to the team. * You become productive in the team's technology stack, applying your existing engineering fundamentals while learning unfamiliar tools or frameworks as needed. * New features and enhancements are delivered against clear requirements and acceptance criteria with maintainability, reliability, and testability in mind. * Existing applications are supported and improved through thoughtful fixes, upgrades, and engineering improvements. * Business partners and teammates can rely on you to communicate clearly, ask the right questions, and collaborate effectively on shared work. * You contribute to a strong engineering environment through quality code, constructive code review, documentation, and continuous learning. **Life at LendingTree** We're a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that's curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **SAFETY SENSITIVE\-YES** **UNIFORM REQUIRED\-NO** The Supervisor, Asset Administration is responsible for: planning, designing, and deploying solutions within the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to enhance the operational and maintenance capabilities of the Little Rock Water Reclamation Authority (LRWRA). Key responsibilities include developing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), analyzing asset data for continuous improvement, and ensuring consistent application of asset management principles. The Supervisor, Asset Administration also leads training efforts for CMMS users and oversees the operation of a multimillion\-dollar inventory storeroom, which is essential to maintaining asset reliability. The storeroom functions as a centralized hub for spare parts, tools, and equipment critical to maintenance and repair operations. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- **PRINCIPAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES (ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS):** * Coordinate startup equipment and training for utility personnel. * Complete project close\-out documentation, including internal work orders (IWO), requisition work orders (RWO), pay estimates, and as\-built records. * Assist the design team with project performance phase activities, including data collection, evaluation, reporting, and certification. * Develop and audit Asset Management Standard Procedures to enhance system capabilities and controls. * Identify and implement improvements to CMMS functionality to support asset lifecycle management and O\&M strategies. * Ensure accurate and consistent data capture aligned with asset management principles. * Analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvement. * Develop and implement KPIs and performance metrics to support continuous improvement and business scorecard objectives. * Create and present reports, dashboards, and visualizations (e.g., workflows, flowcharts) for various organizational levels. * Enhance tracking methods for maintenance, repair, and replacement programs. * Collaborate with departments to review asset usage and identify cost\-saving opportunities. * Apply expertise in CMMS, GIS, and Microsoft Office to support SOP development and strategic planning. * Oversee the operation of a multimillion\-dollar inventory storeroom, ensuring it is well\-organized and adequately stocked. * Manage storeroom personnel and ensure inventory supports daily maintenance and operational needs. * Coordinate and deliver CMMS training for staff across departments. * Coach and support personnel in CMMS\-related activities and best practices. * Maintain organized and accessible documentation for all asset management and project activities. * Ensure compliance with safety practices, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines. * Represent the utility at public meetings as needed. * Perform other duties as assigned that support the utility and the community. * Follow established work procedures and safety guidelines. **LEVEL OF SUPERVISION RECEIVED (minimal, regular, general, daily):** Regular **TOTAL POSITIONS SUPERVISED:** One Storeroom Storekeeper **Typical Qualifications** -------------------------- **QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:** * Associate Degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Drafting \& Design Technology, Construction Technology or Surveying **is preferred.** * A minimum of 3 years cumulative experience in one or more of the following areas: * Engineering related design * CAD, engineering design, and GIS software * Asset Management * Mechanical repair best practices * KPI reporting * Crystal report software or other reporting software * Basic knowledge of SQL queries * Inventory * Asset Reliability best practices * At least 2 years' experience in a supervisory role **is preferred.** * Competency in cmms / Eam software. * Knowledge in the use of computers using Windows based word\-processing, spreadsheet, and database application software. * Ability to operate applicable software programs (i.e., Project, ArcMap, Hansen, iFix, AutoCAD., * Knowledge of principles of accounting. * Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. * Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing with government agencies, consulting engineers, contractors, and the general public. * Ability to read and interpret maps, construction plans and specifications. * Ability to document programs and procedures. * Ability to schedule projects and meet deadlines. * Ability to proofread and edit. * Ability to prepare clear, concise reports. * Ability to remove and replace standard manhole lids. * Ability to work in weather and terrain extremes. * Ability to climb in/out of manholes and other confined spaces, and work with related tools and equipment. * Ability to obtain and maintain an Arkansas driver’s license. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- This position has been evaluated as to whether a momentary lapse of attention may result in grave and immediate danger to the employee, coworkers, or the public. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Frontend
jobs.description: **LUZID** **Software Engineer, Frontend** San Francisco, in\-person 4x/week **About Luzid** Luzid is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people's heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Luzid solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We're a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. We have reached \>$3M ARR in 11 months and raised $21M in funding. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You'll build the interfaces consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. These workflows involve substantial information, interconnected decisions, and work that unfolds over time. Your job is to make that complexity understandable and manageable through thoughtful, responsive software. You'll work closely with design and other engineers, and talk directly to customers to understand where they're encountering friction. You'll help shape what we build, prototype alternatives, ship improvements, and follow through on how they perform in production. Your primary focus will be the frontend: both the experiences users interact with and the foundations that help our team build them well. You'll have room to make consequential technical decisions and the responsibility to keep them practical — using AI\-assisted development tools to explore and iterate, while applying your own judgment to the quality and simplicity of what we ship. **What You'll Do** * **Own product outcomes.** Take ambiguous problems from customer conversations through implementation, deployment, and iteration. * **Build the core interfaces.** Ship the experiences consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. * **Reason from UX back into implementation.** Decide which interactions need to feel instantaneous, how state and data should flow, and when a problem calls for a better component, a different loading strategy, or a change to an API. * **Design for real usage.** Think through loading, empty, error, and recovery states; collaborate closely with design; treat accessibility as part of a complete experience. * **Build durable foundations.** Recognize reusable interaction patterns, design clear component APIs, and use composition and shared primitives to keep the product consistent as it grows. * **Make the product feel fast.** Reason about rendering, network requests, caching, prefetching, and feedback during longer operations — and measure whether changes actually help. * **Work across boundaries.** Reason about APIs, data models, and backend behavior when they affect the frontend, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-use calls. * **Raise the team's bar.** Work independently, communicate decisions clearly, and improve the experience of engineers building alongside you — including how the team uses AI\-assisted workflows. **What We're Looking For** * **Deep frontend fundamentals.** You've shipped and maintained complex interactive applications, and understand JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS, browser behavior, rendering, state management, and asynchronous data flow. * **Strong UX judgment.** You think in terms of how people will actually use a feature, not just whether it works. * **Evidence\-driven.** You combine customer feedback with analytics, performance monitoring, and session replay to identify friction and evaluate the impact of changes. * **Ownership.** You ask questions, challenge assumptions, and care whether what you shipped actually helped, not just whether it shipped. * **Pragmatism.** You know when to use an existing library, when custom implementation is worthwhile, and how to balance immediate delivery with longer\-term maintainability. * **Curiosity and judgment.** Above all, you understand problems deeply, explore possible solutions, and make thoughtful trade\-offs between user experience, engineering quality, speed, and complexity. **Nice to have** * Experience building interfaces for AI\-powered products, including workflows where users review, guide, or approve agent actions. * Experience evolving a component library or design system while continuing to ship product features. * Experience on a small team where you helped shape product and design decisions alongside engineering. * Familiarity with complex enterprise workflows or ecosystems such as SAP, Salesforce, ERP, or CRM. **Why Join Luzid Now** * Shape the interfaces for a product with proven traction inside the largest SAP integrators in the world — delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data — in a category being defined right now. * Own consequential technical decisions on a small, senior team, with a short line between an idea and it being in production. * Build the frontend foundations for a company at $3M\+ ARR after 11 months, backed by $21M in funding, with a team from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. * Work at the center of an emerging category: interfaces where humans and AI agents collaborate on high\-stakes, high\-complexity work.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Take your career further with McLane!** McLane teammates, the driving force behind our success, are diverse professionals who work together seamlessly to keep our operations running smoothly. As a teammate, you will pair your dedication, expertise, and collaborative spirit with your fellow teammates to serve America's most beloved brands. McLane leaders think long\-term, act with purpose, and inspire high performance. They lead with accountability, communicate clearly, and drive results through collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. They empower each teammate to learn from industry leaders, develop their skills, and build lasting connections nationwide. At McLane, we're transforming how technology powers one of America's largest and most stable supply chain organizations. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who is passionate about building scalable cloud\-native applications, solving complex business challenges, and delivering high\-impact solutions that drive operational excellence across the enterprise. Our existing engineering roles emphasize modern cloud platforms, enterprise\-scale solutions, and strong engineering practices, particularly within Google Cloud environments. This is a hybrid position which will require the candidate to report and work from the office at least three days a week. Therefore, interested candidates should be within a 50\-minute radius from Temple, TX. **Benefits you can count on:** * Day 1 Benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, FSA/HSA, and company\-paid life insurance. * Paid time off begins day one. * 401(k) Profit Sharing Plan after 90 days. * Additional benefits: pet insurance, maternity/paternity leave, employee assistance programs, discount programs, tuition reimbursement program, and more! **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full stack applications supporting critical business capabilities. * Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and microservices using Java and/or Python. * Develop modern, responsive user interfaces using React or Vue. * Design and implement cloud\-native solutions primarily within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) while supporting Microsoft Azure environments. * Create and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. * Build and enhance RESTful APIs and event\-driven integrations. * Collaborate with architects, product owners, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation initiatives, and cloud deployment strategies. * Participate in code reviews and champion engineering best practices, security, scalability, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues while driving continuous improvement. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field required. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full stack development. * Strong backend development experience with: Java (Spring Boot/Quarkus) and/or Python (Django or Flask) * Solid front\-end development experience using: React, Flutter, Vue.js * Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure. * Experience building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. * Strong understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture. * Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DB2, or Oracle. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based development workflows, and code review practices. * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively within a hybrid, cross\-functional team environment. * This position requires the ability to read, write, and understand English at a level sufficient to perform job\-related tasks effectively and safely. This includes understanding work instructions, safety protocols, and communications essential to the role. The requirement is directly related to the nature of the job and ensures compliance with workplace safety and operational standards. **Fit the following? We want you here!** * Teamwork oriented. * Organized. * Problem solver. * Detailed. **Our roadmap. Our story.** We've been forging our path as a leader in the distribution industry since 1894\. Building an expansive nationwide network of team members for 130\+ years has allowed us to stay agile for our clients across the restaurant, retail, and e\-commerce industries. We look to the future and are ready to continue making industry\-defining moves by embracing the newest technology into our practices, continuing team member training, and emphasizing our people\-centered culture. Candidates may be subject to a background check and drug screen, in accordance with applicable laws. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. For our complete EEO and Pay Transparency statement, please visit https://www.mclaneco.com/legal/employment/

jobs.title: Maintenance Tech II
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Under minimal supervision, set up, adjust, perform preventative maintenance, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain assigned equipment with responsibility for production and quality. **Job Description** **MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Perform preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and ad\-hoc repairs on assigned conveyors, automation, robotics and ancillary equipment as needed. * Perform routine troubleshooting of assigned out of service equipment and correct issues, act as an escalation point for lower level technicians, and escalate to leadership and/or more senior technicians as needed. Record all maintenance issues in maintenance log for each line. * Document all work in the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and ticketing systems as appropriate and maintain accurate records of all operating logs for fire pumps, generators, HVAC equipment, and other facility systems that are tested on a routine basis. * Mentor all maintenance personnel in developing appropriate skillsets and knowledge of equipment. * Assist maintenance mechanics in work that requires two people or when operational needs demand. * Perform facility/building project work as assigned. Tasks include, but are not limited to, light bulb/ballast replacement, door repairs, furniture installation, ceiling tile replacement, carpentry duties, plumbing repairs and maintaining operation logs. * Assemble and test equipment to verify correct operation and production. Analyze and record cause of roduction delays on daily production reports and initiate procedures to solve equipment malfunctions. Examine defects and analyze spoilage causes and, where possible, take corrective action and verify the corrective action has eliminated the problems. * Ability to certify on all industrial lift equipment. Pickers, Reaches, Skates, Booms, Scissor lifts, etc. * Oversee projects as assigned. Projects will include minor space renovations, inventory management, contractor oversight, and building efficiency improvements. Oversee, inspect, and monitor the routine maintenance provided by junior engineers. Will also provide guidance and training as needed. * **MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:** **Education:** * High school diploma or equivalent **Certification / Licensure:** * None **Work Experience:** * 5 year of experience with a forklift, conveyor and general equipment repair and maintenance * Experience troubleshooting complex equipment. **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:** None * **PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:** **Education:** * Associates Degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, HVAC, orequivalent. **Certification / Licensure:** * Graduate of an apprenticeship program or hold current trade certification. **Work Experience:** * None **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:** * Fundamental understanding of machinery/equipment * Basic skill level in multiple computer software packages including Microsoft Excel * Experience working with inputs, outputs, and PLC logic systems and ability to troubleshoot these systems * Willing to travel at least/up to 10% of the time for business purposes (within state and out of state). * Must be willing to learn new equipment as it is brought on\-line. * Physical activities necessary to perform one or more essential functions of the position. * Ability to bend, twist, reach, push, lift for extended periods daily * Frequently move, lift, carry supplies/equipment up to 50 lbs and may have to occasionally lift up to 75 lbs * Must be able to stand for minimum of 8 hours and up to 12 hours for up to 6 days a week * Ability to continuously ascend and descend from ladders and stairs, work at heights and/or from a ladder, work from a lying down position, work with your hands above your head. * Willing to operate material handling equipment (i.e. fork truck). * Write documents and reports using writing instruments and computers * Read information, often in small print (drawings) * Follow appropriate safety procedures such as Lock Out/Tag Out, Arc Flash, etc. and use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while maintaining equipment, and ensure a safe work environment by eliminating potential equipment safety hazards * Ability to work overtime and must be available for on\-call requests as needed Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education \& training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization. The anticipated salary range for this position: $30\.00 \- $43\.50 Hourly The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold. Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp. We’re dedicated to creating a Medline where everyone feels they belong and can grow their career. We strive to do this by seeking diversity in all forms, acting inclusively, and ensuring that people have tools and resources to perform at their best. Explore our Belonging page here . Medline Industries, LP is an equal opportunity employer. Medline evaluates qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, neurodivergence, protected veteran status, marital or family status, caregiver responsibilities, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: ASIC Engineer, Implementation - Timing
jobs.description: Meta's Infrastructure Silicon team is seeking an ASIC Implementation Engineer specializing in timing to help design and deliver custom silicon for data center applications. In this role, you will drive static timing analysis and timing closure across complex System on Chip designs, working at the intersection of front\-end and back\-end implementation to ensure our infrastructure chips meet performance, power, and area targets at advanced process nodes. ### **ASIC Engineer, Implementation \- Timing Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain timing constraints (SDC) for complex SoC designs, including clock definitions, input/output delays, multicycle paths, and false paths * Perform static timing analysis using industry\-standard sign\-off tools to identify and resolve setup, hold, and clock skew violations across hierarchical design blocks * Drive timing closure through collaboration with physical design engineers, providing guidance on placement, routing, and clock tree synthesis to meet timing targets * Analyze and debug timing paths across multiple clock domains, identifying critical paths and recommending RTL or physical implementation optimizations * Generate and validate timing reports for sign\-off across process, voltage, and temperature corners, including on\-chip variation analysis * Develop and maintain timing exception methodologies and waiver processes in coordination with design and verification teams * Contribute to the development and improvement of timing closure scripts and automation flows using scripting languages to increase efficiency and repeatability * Interface with foundry and library teams to characterize and integrate timing libraries, including standard cells, memories, and hard IP * Support design handoff between front\-end and back\-end teams by providing timing\-aware synthesis netlists and constraint validation ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of experience in ASIC implementation with a focus on static timing analysis and timing closure * Experience with industry\-standard static timing analysis and sign\-off tools such as PrimeTime or equivalent * Experience developing and validating SDC timing constraints for complex SoC or IP designs * Experience with logic synthesis tools and timing\-driven optimization techniques * Experience scripting in Python, Tcl, or Perl to automate timing analysis and reporting flows ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with RTL design or synthesis using SystemVerilog or other hardware description languages * Experience with timing closure at advanced process nodes (7nm or below), including on\-chip variation and multi\-corner multi\-mode analysis * Familiarity with physical design concepts such as placement, routing, and parasitic extraction as they relate to timing closure * Experience with clock tree synthesis and clock network optimization in the context of timing sign\-off ### **About jobs.title: ASIC Engineer, Power
jobs.description: Meta is building custom silicon to power the infrastructure that underlies its family of products and services. As an ASIC Engineer specializing in power on the EDA Infrastructure team, you will develop and maintain power analysis and optimization flows that enable silicon engineers across the organization to accurately model, estimate, and reduce power consumption in custom ASIC designs. In this role, you will work at the intersection of EDA tooling, physical design, and power methodology, helping to define the infrastructure that shapes how Meta's next\-generation chips are designed and verified. ### **ASIC Engineer, Power Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain power analysis flows including dynamic and static power estimation, vectorless analysis, and power intent verification using industry\-standard EDA tools * Define and implement power methodology guidelines for RTL, synthesis, and physical design stages of the ASIC development flow * Collaborate with RTL design, physical design, and verification teams to identify and resolve power hotspots and inefficiencies across custom ASIC designs * Build and optimize EDA infrastructure scripts and automation frameworks to improve power signoff accuracy and turnaround time * Evaluate and integrate commercial and internally developed EDA tools into the power analysis flow, providing technical assessments and recommendations * Develop power intent specifications using UPF or CPF and ensure consistent application across design and implementation stages * Establish power budgets and track power metrics across design milestones, communicating results and risks to cross\-functional stakeholders * Drive continuous improvement of power closure methodologies by analyzing results across multiple tape\-outs and identifying systemic opportunities * Provide technical guidance to other engineers on power analysis best practices, flow usage, and debug techniques * Partner with EDA tool vendors to evaluate new capabilities and influence tool roadmaps to meet Meta silicon design requirements ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 6\+ years of experience in ASIC design or physical design with a focus on power analysis, power optimization, or power signoff * Experience developing or maintaining EDA flows for power analysis using tools such as Synopsys PrimePower, Cadence Voltus, or equivalent * Experience with power intent specification languages such as UPF or CPF and their application across RTL\-to\-GDSII flows * Experience scripting in Python, Tcl, or shell to build and automate EDA infrastructure workflows * Experience collaborating across RTL design, physical design, and verification disciplines to drive power closure on complex ASIC designs ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience evaluating and qualifying new EDA tools or methodologies in a production silicon environment * Familiarity with custom or semi\-custom design flows for high\-performance computing or data center silicon * Experience with low\-power design techniques including clock gating, power gating, multi\-voltage domain design, and dynamic voltage and frequency scaling * Background in developing internal EDA infrastructure tooling or flow automation at scale across multiple concurrent design projects ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and jobs.description: Meta is seeking a Director, Hardware Supply Chain Planning to serve as a senior individual contributor for server rack and component planning across Meta’s infrastructure supply chain. jobs.title: Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: As a Sustaining Reliability Engineer at Meta Reality Labs, you will set the technical direction for the long\-term reliability and quality of consumer hardware products after launch across Meta's device portfolio, including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. In this role, you will own reliability engineering strategy for the installed base and for products scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and you will drive systemic resolution of field failures to root cause and corrective action across product families. You will define the metrics, methodologies, and reaction frameworks the organization uses to sustain field performance, influence design and architectural decisions on current and next\-generation products, and partner with and influence cross\-functional leaders and external suppliers. You will be a recognized technical authority who leverages data to identify population\-based reliability and quality risks in both the factory and the field, and who mentors and elevates other engineers across the function. ### **Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer Responsibilities:** * Own the reliability and quality engineering strategy and metrics (field return rate, failure rate, and quality KPIs) for all products actively out in the market or currently scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and set the bar for what good looks like across the portfolio * Drive systemic resolution of field performance issues, component obsolescence, and return\-rate (RMA/warranty) optimization to root cause and corrective action, in partnership with cross\-functional internal and external partners, including recurring and cross\-product failure modes * Partner with and influence internal leaders and external suppliers to ensure long\-term hardware field performance, and close the loop by institutionalizing lessons learned into design, NPI, and supplier processes * Define and own the field signal analytics, product health telemetry, and failure\-reaction frameworks the organization relies on * set thresholds and escalation triggers for products in the field * Establish the standards, methodologies, and metrics for sustaining reliability and quality, including ongoing reliability testing (e.g., ORT), excursion/ECO assessment, post\-ramp qualifications (PRQ) and change control against reliability and quality goals * Lead complex, multidisciplinary root cause analysis for reliability and quality escapes, distinguishing between design, material, manufacturing\-process, and use\-condition contributors, and drive corrective actions to closure * Provide Design\-for\-Reliability and architectural evaluations that carry field and sustaining learnings into new product categories and next\-generation designs * Own the quality management system for products in sustaining * understand, analyze, and resolve field quality issues and influence internal teams to drive durable quality improvements * Translate reliability and quality data into risk assessments, reports, and positions that inform executive product and business decisions * Mentor and technically guide reliability and quality engineers across the function, raising the capability of the team ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Materials, or Electrical Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 10\+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering and/or product quality for consumer electronics, wearable devices, or similar electro\-mechanical products * Knowledge of mechanical design, material science, and the failure mechanisms of consumer electronics * Experience driving root cause analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and corrective action on complex hardware systems * Experience analyzing reliability data, field return, and warranty metrics to identify systemic failure trends and drive engineering corrective actions * Knowledge of industry test standards including ASTM, MIL, JEDEC, and IEC * Knowledge of failure analysis techniques and tools including optical microscopy, X\-Ray, CT scan, SEM, EDX, and FTIR * Experience independently driving decisions and dependencies across multiple teams or functions in a dynamic environment ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Track record of defining mission profiles and reliability/quality strategy for new product categories * Experience with data mining and data visualization to make strategic business decisions, and with Asia high\-volume manufacturing and external partner relationship management * MS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent discipline * Familiarity with Weibull analysis, reliability growth modeling, and statistical reliability prediction methods * 12\+ years of experience, including field/sustaining reliability and post\-launch product improvement for VR, AR, or wearable device product lines (display, optics, battery, sensor subsystem failure modes) * Experience with quality and statistics tools and methodology (8D, PFMEA, SPC, DOE) * Certified Quality Engineer or Lean/Six Sigma Black Belt * Experience using AI tools to redesign reliability/quality data analysis workflows, accelerate failure\-pattern identification, or improve reporting efficiency ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Technology, Tech & Engineer Fellow (Spring)
jobs.description: **Job ID:** 17463 **Business Unit:** MTA Headquarters **Location:** New York, NY, United States **Regular/Temporary:** Intern **Department:** Platforms Technology **Date Posted:** Sep 25, 2026 **Description** Department: MTA IT Location: 333 West 34th Street, New York, NY Position Title: ServiceNow Platform Technology, Tech \& Engineering Fellow Hourly Rate: $21\.00 (Undergraduate), $23\.00 (Graduate) All internship positions are onsite and require regular, in\-person attendance at the designated work location. **OVERVIEW OF DEPARTMENT:** The Enterprise Platform Technology Department at the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) is part of MTA’s Corporate Services Information Technology division. This department is responsible for architecting, managing, and scaling the core enterprise platforms critical to MTA’s operations. Our job is to take care of the major software platforms that help the MTA run smoothly every day. Think of this team as the group that keeps the MTA’s essential technology “systems of record and workflow engines” working, safe, updated, and connected to each other. An intern assigned to the ServiceNow Platform would support basic platform configuration, assist with documentation of the building or updating of catalog items, forms, and simple workflows, and help with testing changes in the development environment. They would also work on documentation, shadow platform manager on projects, and complete small, supervised enhancement tasks to learn core ServiceNow concepts and contribute to the team’s workload. This position begins in Spring 2027; candidates should be ready to commit minimum of 12‑months in the role. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** Welcome \& Basics * Gain access to the ServiceNow development and test environments, documentation, and collaboration tools. * Learn what ServiceNow is, how the MTA uses it, and the core applications supported by the platform. * Complete beginner‑friendly ServiceNow training modules to build foundational skills. * Shadow team members to observe daily administrative and support activities. Core Platform Concepts * Learn key platform components such as tables, records, forms, and lists. * Practice updating form layouts, adding simple fields, and exploring related lists in the development environment. * Understand update sets and why they are important for managing platform changes. * Get exposure to basic platform roles and access control concepts. Service Catalog \& Flow Designer * Learn how the Service Catalog works and how catalog items support business processes. * Build or modify simple catalog items with guided support from the team. * Gain a conceptual understanding of Flow Designer, including triggers, actions, and approvals. Light Scripting Exposure * Learn how JavaScript used in ServiceNow. * Review examples of basic client scripts and business rules. * Make supervised updates to simple logic in the development environment and practice using the Script Debugger. Testing \& Quality Practices * Support the testing of catalog items, workflows, and UI changes. * Apply basic QA concepts such as writing test cases, documenting results, and verifying expected behavior. * Execute tests for non‑critical sprint items and log defects or improvement recommendations. Governance \& Documentation * Learn platform best practices and the role of governance. * Follow naming conventions, version control practices, and migration guidelines. * Support the creation and updates to documentation such as process flows, feature descriptions, and small technical notes. * Observe a change review meeting to understand how platform decisions are made. **PROJECTS:** Knowledge Base Cleanup or Improvement * Review KB articles for accuracy, duplication, or outdated content. * Support articles rewrites using platform style guidelines. * Suggest improvements for knowledge categories or tagging. Build a Reporting or Dashboard Widget * Support the creation of a dashboard showing ticket counts by category or week. * Support creation of reports to identify catalog items with missing fields. * Assist with teach tables, filters, KPIs, and platform data structure. Documentation Project: “ServiceNow Starter Guide” * Assist with outlining Platform terminology * Contribute to table structure diagrams * Collaborate on Step\-by\-step guides for common admin tasks * Supports creation of a resource for future interns and junior hires **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is a must. * The candidate should possess organizational, analytical and communication skills. * The candidate should be able to work well under pressure and prioritize tasks effectively. * The candidate should have a keen eye for detail and be able to work independently while being an active team player. * Comfortable with JavaScript basics. * Able to read and modify small code snippets. * Understands data structures and simple logic. * Coursework or projects involving web development ,low code/no code platforms, or business process design. **REQUIRED EDUCATION:** * Matriculated in an undergraduate program in good standing with at least 2\.5 GPA AND/OR matriculated in a graduate program in good standing with at least 2\.8 GPA * Major(s) Preferred: Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related technology discipline. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Students’ transcript must be submitted. **Equal Employment Opportunity** MTA and its subsidiary and affiliated agencies are Equal Opportunity Employers, including with respect to veteran status and individuals with disabilities. The MTA encourages qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, including military service members, to apply.

jobs.title: Field Applications Engineer - Associate
jobs.description: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The Customer Engineering organization serves as the primary technical interface for our global customers and helps ensure that Micron solutions are seamlessly integrated into next\-generation technology platforms. Our team coordinates deep engineering engagements, technical product qualifications, and architecture reviews to secure design wins and grow market share. We are dedicated to providing world\-class technical support that accelerates revenue and builds long\-term strategic partnerships with our customers. **Role Description:** --------------------- The Field Applications Engineer \- Associate plays a vital role in achieving the technical achievements needed to launch products. You will be an important member of our field engineering team. In this position, you will oversee many end\-to\-end technical tasks, including sophisticated product sample deployments, lifecycle management, addressing technical questions, and other customer interactions. You should adopt an "automation\-first" approach to actively find ways to improve processes and apply AI\-based workflows in daily operations when possible. This role can lead to a full\-time FAE career for individuals who achieve the right results. It also requires demonstrating the right skills and behaviors. **Example Responsibilities:** ----------------------------- * Coordinate the entire process of technical product samples, beginning with configuration and continuing through international shipment tracking to final customer validation * Coordinate and track technical product processes across multiple customer accounts * Serve as a point of contact for technical product inquiries for some customers and partners to resolve standard questions and raise complex engineering issues for deeper analysis * Maintain and update technical product documentation, qualification statuses, and project data within internal systems as well as, in certain instances, customer\-facing web portals * Orchestrate the communication and execution of jobs.title: Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Cloud Network Engineer Microsoft’s Cloud Operations \& Innovation (CO\+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Cloud Network Engineer you will perform a key role in delivering the Critical Environments infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. This will include performing network design and/or network operations work to enhance the availability and scalability of the CE Network, participate in on\-call DRI rotation to provide support, and perform complex incident management and problem resolution for network and security systems. This is a high visibility position in an area of investment for Microsoft and offers fantastic opportunities for technical and career growth. With a flexible workplace, you can work from home partially or fully and/or come to the office/lab on an as\-needed basis. As a group, CO\+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity \& Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever\-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world\-class cloud provider. Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO\+I and be at the forefront of the action! **Responsibilities** **Network Design and Implementation** * Perform technical analysis and lead the design architecture of network plans for the enterprise, analyzing network \& security requirements of the business and architects’ solutions that include highly available and resilient designs. * Install, upgrade, and maintain network or security hardware and operating system and software as needed, leveraging automation with experience in network hardware from Cisco, Arista and Palo Alto. **Maintaining and Operating Networks** * Participate in on\-call DRI rotation to support Network Infrastructure services. * Oversee complex infrastructure network or security projects, including design, deployment, and monitoring, and perform complex incident management and problem resolution for network and security systems. * Handle Layer 3 technologies, including IPv4, BGP, EIGRP, OSPF, IPv6, HSRP, and VRRP. Apply strong technical knowledge of enterprise networking solutions for very large environments, at scale (e.g., MPLS/BGP, routing, switching, SDN/NFV, EVPN VXLAN), and have knowledge of SD\-WAN technologies. * Monitor network system state using tools such as SNMP, Sflow/netflow, and Telemetry, in compliance with current capacity plan guidelines, and network services budgets, including reviewing invoices from service providers for usage, errors, and inconsistencies, and making adjustments where feasible. **Supporting People** * Collaborate with Information Technology staff and business personnel in the creation and turnover of solutions for production\-level operations, and act as a source for direction, training, and guidance for less experienced department staff, demonstrating leadership ability in a fast\-paced environment. **Other** * Embody our culture and values**.** **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 1\+ year(s) technical experience in network design, development, and automation OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 2\+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 8\+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation + OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 5\+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation + OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3\+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation + OR Doctorate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. * 3\+ years’ experience with network authentication systems such as TACACS\+ (Cisco ISE, Duo) * Possession of Industry certifications within the network Engineering CCNP or CCIE Route \& Switch and work with industrial control systems. Cloud Network Engineering IC3 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 \- $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 \- $219,200 per year. jobs.title: Data Scientist II, M365 Copilot
jobs.description: **Overview** Come build the core of Microsoft Copilot for enterprise with Microsoft Turing Team, where you'll join a collaborative group of applied scientists and engineers pushing the frontier of large language models (LLMs) to improve the productivity of hundreds of millions of users around the world. Our team is responsible for the core systems that power Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat delivering intelligence, quality, and transformative new features. We work at the intersection of research and engineering—advancing orchestrator reasoning, training next\-generation models, and shipping impactful, model\-driven experiences in Microsoft 365 Copilot. As a **Data Scientist II**\- M365 Copilot, you will: \- Build and deliver model\-driven features from concept to production \- spanning model development, evaluation, metrics, and A/B testing\- Evolve our orchestrator to reason more effectively, respond faster, and support new capabilities in multi\-modality, agent\-based systems, and beyond. We’re hiring a **Data Scientist II** who is passionate about deep learning, NLP, multimodality model, and model optimization. Come build the next generation of AI with us. experience in financial services or other mission\-critical environments is a plus * Demonstrated experience designing and commissioning at least one liquid cooling technology, including direct liquid cooling, cold\-plate, rear\-door heat exchanger, or immersion cooling solutions * Strong mechanical engineering knowledge of chilled water, glycol, and refrigerant\-based cooling systems, including pump sizing, pipe stress, flow analysis, cooling distribution units, secondary\-loop hydraulics, and leak detection * Working knowledge of critical electrical systems, including UPS topology, generator sizing, switchgear, PDUs, single\-line diagrams, and integrated systems testing * Experience delivering MEP capital projects from design through commissioning and operational handoff * Familiarity with ASHRAE TC 9\.9 guidelines, Uptime Institute Tier methodology, EN 50600, NFPA 70, IEC 60364, and applicable building and electrical safety requirements * Proficiency with CAD or BIM tools such as AutoCAD or Revit MEP and thermal\-modeling tools such as 6SigmaDC, Future Facilities, or comparable platforms * Strong documentation, project coordination, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently across global sites and travel up to 30% The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Integrity
jobs.description: WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** The NBA’s Basketball Strategy \& Growth department is seeking an analytics engineer to own the ingestion and transformation of the data that powers the Integrity Team’s work on the league’s gaming policy. The role is responsible for turning disparate and inconsistent external feeds — data from betting partners and operators, open\-source intelligence (OSINT), and third\-party vendors — into well\-modeled, tested, and documented datasets, and for integrating those feeds with internal league basketball data so that betting activity can be evaluated in the context of what happened on the court. These models are the foundation for downstream data science and machine learning work: the anomaly detection, alerting, and AI\-driven software the Integrity Team uses to surface conduct that may violate the gaming policy. The analytics engineer joins a team of data scientists, engineers and basketball experts and collaborates closely with the Legal department on any investigation relating to a potential violation of the gaming policy. The work is confidential, frequently time\-sensitive, and expected to hold up to legal scrutiny — lineage, definitions, and data quality controls matter as much as speed. **Major Responsibilities** * Own the ingestion of data from disparate betting partners, operators, and data vendors — each with its own schema, granularity, delivery cadence, and idiosyncrasies — and normalize them into a consistent, conformed model of markets, wagers, prices, and accounts. * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for OSINT and other unstructured or semi\-structured sources, including the entity resolution work required to link external identities to known accounts and subjects. * Integrate betting and OSINT data with internal league basketball data — schedule, play\-by\-play, box score, tracking, officiating, and player availability data — so that activity can be analyzed in game context. * Develop production\-ready analytical data models in dbt on Snowflake, applying dimensional modeling and analytics engineering best practices, including layered staging and mart designs, incremental models, and consistent naming conventions. * Create curated, reusable pipelines and feature\-ready datasets that support downstream data science and machine learning work, including model development, backtesting, and production inference. * Implement automated data quality testing, freshness and volume monitoring, and reconciliation checks on incoming feeds so that vendor changes, outages, or silent data loss are detected before they affect investigative output. * Build and manage orchestration and scheduling for pipelines, including dependency management, retries, alerting, and service levels appropriate to time\-sensitive feeds. * Develop and maintain a semantic layer with standardized business definitions and metrics so that analysts, data scientists, and the Legal department work from a single version of the truth. * Document models, sources, lineage, and assumptions to support knowledge transfer, auditability, and the evidentiary needs of investigations. * Onboard new betting partners and data providers — evaluating feed quality, defining requirements and specifications with providers, and absorbing vendor schema changes without breaking downstream consumers. * Partner with data scientists to translate analytical and modeling requirements into scalable data models, and with the full stack engineer to expose those datasets to the platform’s backend jobs and UI. * Apply appropriate access controls, data classification, and retention practices to sensitive betting, personal, and investigative data. **Required Skills/Knowledge** * Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience developing complex analytical data models. * Production experience with analytics engineering frameworks such as dbt, including testing, documentation, macros, and managing a large model DAG. * Production experience with Snowflake, including performance and cost management such as warehouse sizing, clustering, and query tuning. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics engineering best practices. * Understanding of sports betting markets — odds, line movement, limits, player props, and market maker behavior — and of basketball data such as play\-by\-play, box score, and tracking data. * Proficiency in Python for ingestion, API integration, and data processing. * Experience integrating data from multiple external partners or vendors, including messy, high\-volume, semi\-structured, and unstructured sources. * Experience building and operating orchestrated data pipelines, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and monitoring. * Experience developing semantic layers, standardized business definitions, and reusable analytical datasets. * n working as part of a team, collaborating effectively both within BSG Integrity and cross\-functionally. **Preferred Skills/Knowledge** * Experience with Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and/or ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow. * Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or a comparable orchestration platform. * Experience with entity resolution, identity matching, or record linkage. * Familiarity with MLOps practices such as feature pipelines, model registries, training/retraining workflows, and model monitoring. * Prior work on integrity, surveillance, fraud, AML, or trust and safety data is a plus. * Experience in sports, gaming, or another regulated or compliance\-driven environment is a plus. **Experience/Education** * Bachelor’s degree required in a technical or quantitative field; master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or developing analytical data models on cloud\-based data platforms. **Salary Range:** $130,000\-$150,000 **Job Posting Title:** Senior Manager Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company\-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; fertility and family\-forming assistance; wellbeing allowance; educational assistance; mental health coaching/therapy; tax advantaged accounts such as HSA and healthcare/dependent care FSAs; a 401(k) retirement plan; and time off benefits that include vacation, sick time, and personal days. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. The NBA is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace. To safeguard our employees and their families, our visitors, and the broader community from COVID\-19, and in consideration of recommendations from health authorities and the NBA’s own advisors, any individual working onsite in our New York and New Jersey offices must be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19\. The NBA will discuss accommodations for individuals who cannot be vaccinated due to a medical reason or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance. **About the NBA** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in 60 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2024\-25 season featured a record\-tying 125 international players from a record\-tying 43 countries. NBA Digital’s assets include NBA TV, NBA.com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2\.3 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA’s global social responsibility platform, partners with renowned community\-based organizations around the world to address important social issues in the areas of education, inclusion, youth and family development, and health and wellness.

jobs.description: NationsBenefits is recognized as one of the fastest\-growing companies in America and a Healthcare Fintech provider of supplemental benefits, flex cards, and member engagement solutions.
