jobs.title: Health AI Engineer
jobs.description: Required Qualifications: * B.A/B.S. in Biomedical/Health Informatics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative or technical discipline plus at least five years of relevant experience or a combination of education and relevant work experience to equal at least nine years * Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, software engineering principles, and computational methods. * Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java; experience with SQL and familiarity with C/C\+\+ or other programming languages. Candidates should be able to demonstrate programming proficiency through prior projects or sample code. * Understanding of healthcare data, biomedical data, and common health AI and informatics applications. * Experience developing, implementing, testing, and evaluating data science, machine learning, or AI solutions. * Ability to work independently, manage assigned research and engineering tasks, and adapt to a rapidly evolving scientific and technical environment. Preferred Qualifications: * Research or applied experience in health data science, biomedical informatics, artificial intelligence, and real\-world health data analytics. * Experience working with electronic health record (EHR) data, clinical text, or other large\-scale biomedical datasets. * Knowledge of medical terminologies and ontologies, such as UMLS, SNOMED CT, ICD, RxNorm, or related standards. * Experience with natural language processing, large language models (LLMs), generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and/or agentic AI systems. * Experience evaluating AI systems, including model performance, robustness, generalizability, and reliability in healthcare applications. * Experience contributing to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, or research proposals. * Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams of faculty, clinicians, research scientists, engineers, students, and other research professionals. CHS develops and applies innovative data science and AI methods to analyze complex biomedical and healthcare data, with the goal of advancing biomedical research, clinical care, and learning health systems. The Natural Language Processing / Information Extraction (NLP/IE) Program (https://healthinformatics.umn.edu/natural\-language\-processing) brings together faculty investigators, research scientists, engineers, postdoctoral researchers, programmers, and students to develop and evaluate NLP and AI methods for a broad range of clinical and biomedical applications. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Data Engineer creates and maintains data pipelines for key data and analytics capabilities in the enterprise. This position works in collaboration with analytics and data warehousing staff, DBAs and subject matter experts to create reliable processes that load targeted data with integrity and quality, enabling it for strategic use by the business. Collaborate within an agile, multi\-disciplinary team to develop optimal data integration and transformation solutions. Document and analyze data requirements (functional and non\-functional) to develop scalable, automated, fault\-tolerant data pipeline solutions for business and technology initiatives. Profile data to assess the accuracy and completeness of data sources and work with business partners to mitigate issues. Build and maintain data pipelines for using appropriate tools and practices in development, test and production environments. Design with modularity to leverage reuse of code wherever possible. Create data mappings, programs, routines and SQL to acquire data from legacy, web, cloud and purchased package environments into the analytics environment. Use a mix of ELT, ETL, data virtualization and other methods to optimize the balance of minimal data movement against performance. Maintain metadata management processes and documentation. Monitor data quality to detect emerging issues and consult with the team to create transformation rules to cleanse against defined rules and standards. Participate in code reviews and unit testing to optimize performance and minimize issues. **Job Specifications** *Typically has the following skills or abilities:* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, economics or related functional area; or equivalent experience Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to gather requirements and effectively collaborate with teammates and business partners 4\+ years’ experience working in a development team providing analytical capabilities 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in the data space spanning data preparation, SQL, integration tools, ETL/ELT / data pipeline design SQL coding experience Familiarity with agile development environments (Scrum, Kanban) with a focus on Continuous Integration and Delivery Previous experience using a data integration platform (IBM InfoSphere DataStage, Oracle Data Integrator, Informatica PowerCenter, MS SSIS, AWS Glue, Denodo), and familiarity with data warehouse MPP platforms such Snowflake, Netezza, Teradata, Redshift, etc. Familiarity with event store and stream processing (Apache Kafka and platforms like Confluent) and with API development and management platforms (MuleSoft, Axway) is also beneficial Capable of focusing on a specific set of tasks while also ensuring alignment to a broader strategic design Exhibits the traits of a pro\-active, self\-driven contributor, who values continual learning and the adoption of new technology For roles that are remote (i.e., Work From Home (WFH)) or hybrid (i.e., partial onsite at a VSP location and WFH), must demonstrate a high level of engagement in virtual environments, including maintaining camera presence during meetings to support effective communication and team alignment Compensation range for the role is listed below. jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you'll be doing:** Verizon’s Exposure and Vulnerability Management (EVM) Engineering and Reporting team is seeking a Sr. AI and Data Engineer to lead the development of our security data architecture, web infrastructure, and artificial intelligence models. In this role, you will be the hands\-on driving force building scalable data pipelines, managing the web infrastructure that hosts our reporting solutions, and developing AI models to predict and prioritize cybersecurity vulnerabilities. While you will build AI and predictive analytics solutions, your primary focus will be engineering the robust data pipelines, databases, and web services that make those intelligent insights possible. You will have the opportunity to influence the blueprint of how diverse asset data is structured, securely hosted, and meaningfully delivered to the security organization. By engineering scalable data models, reliable web infrastructure, and intelligent AI pipelines, you will help ensure our infrastructure is ready for predictive analytics and that our reporting solutions provide proactive, automated insights rather than just historical data. Key Responsibilities include: * Data Pipeline \& Architecture: Design, construct, and maintain highly scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that ingest, transform, and centralize complex security data from numerous Systems of Record (SoR) into the Cyber Data Hub. * Web Infrastructure \& API Management: Build, maintain, and optimize the backend web infrastructure required to securely serve data dashboards, reporting portals, and AI model endpoints to end\-users. * Database Engineering: Engineer comprehensive data models (conceptual, logical, physical) and optimize relational and non\-relational database architectures for both high\-volume transactional processing and BI/analytics workloads. * AI \& Predictive Analytics: Develop and deploy machine learning models and intelligent automation to enhance vulnerability risk scoring, utilizing the data foundations and infrastructure you have built. * Frameworks \& Automation: Create reusable, automated frameworks and CI/CD workflows for data processing, web deployments, and model training to ensure low\-touch, sustainable operations. * Data Integrity \& Governance: Implement strict data quality checks, schema validations, and compliance safeguards to ensure the absolute integrity of downstream reporting and AI inputs. * Environment Management: Maintain and monitor our web servers, databases, ML staging, and UAT reporting environments to ensure high availability and reliable, secure deployment of EVM products. * Technical Leadership: Translate complex security program needs into concrete data and infrastructure tasks, guiding junior engineers and serving as a key technical liaison between security operations and core engineering. ### **What We’re Looking For:** We need a builder with a vision—someone who views complex security problems through the lens of data architecture, scalable web infrastructure, and intelligent automation. You should be deeply analytical, thrilled by processing massive datasets, capable of maintaining the web services that deliver those insights, and eager to leverage AI to stay ahead of emerging threats. You flourish in fast\-paced environments and possess the technical credibility to guide both infrastructure execution and architectural direction. You'll need to have: * Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of job\-related work experience, military experience, or specialized training or education (non\-collegiate). * Experience in Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, ETL processes, and algorithmic development. * Advanced expertise in writing, optimizing, and debugging complex queries and schemas for relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and non\-relational (MongoDB, Elasticsearch) databases, as well as modern Data Warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery). * Proven experience deploying, securing, and maintaining web infrastructure, REST APIs, and backend frameworks, as well as working with web servers/proxies. * Hands\-on experience developing predictive models and integrating ML libraries into production web environments. * Prior experience engineering within a Vulnerability Management program or Cyber Security organization. Even Better if You Have: * Exceptional ability to translate client needs into achievable technical requirements and present infrastructure/data roadmaps to executive leadership. * Advanced experience with cloud\-native web hosting, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architecture. * Experience fine\-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) or building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks to run on top of your data infrastructure. * Understanding of security frameworks (NIST, SOX, FISMA) and the full IT stack (OS, Network, Cloud, SDLC). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing AI & Automation
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Zillow Group is seeking a Director, Marketing AI \& Automation to lead a new team within Marketing, Technology \& Operations. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $219,500\.00 \- $350,600\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. Familiarity with a modern composable stack (CDP, reverse ETL, cloud data platform, enterprise LLM tooling) highly valued * Enablement mindset: Track record running a center\-led function that transferred capability outward as it matured, rather than accumulating ownership. Experience standing up a center of excellence or platform team from zero a plus * Governance judgment: Experience managing brand, legal, and privacy risk in AI systems, and building the review mechanisms rather than resisting them * Influence without authority: Able to drive outcomes that land inside other teams, on other roadmaps, without direct control * Build\-versus\-buy judgment: Experience evaluating and managing AI and martech vendors, with a clear view of when a platform partner beats an internal build * * Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a technical or business field (MBA, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics) a plus **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. jobs.title: Junior Electrical & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Aescape is a New York\-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes\-driven practice. Powered by real\-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures. **Aescape** is looking for a **Junior Electrical \& Firmware Engineer** to join our hardware team and work across the electronics and embedded software that make our robot move and sense. You will support schematic and PCB design, write and debug firmware on our embedded platforms, and spend significant time on the bench bringing boards up, instrumenting them, and fault finding across hardware and firmware. This is a hands\-on early\-career role on a small, senior team: you will be mentored closely by experienced engineers, given ownership of meaningful subsystems early, and you will ship hardware that real people experience with their bodies. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! **This role is based out of our NYC office in Chelsea, onsite 5 days per week.** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Electrical Design Support:** Support schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout review for motor drive, sensing, power, and control electronics. Read datasheets closely, run the calculations behind a part choice, and help carry boards from design through fabrication and assembly. * **Firmware Development:** Write, test, and debug embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ on our microcontroller platforms: peripheral drivers, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), sensor integration, and device control. Work within our version control, code review, and release practices. * **Board Bring\-Up \& Debug:** Bring up new hardware on the bench, and debug across the electrical and firmware boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power supplies, and debuggers. Solder, rework, and instrument your own test setups. * **Test \& Characterization:** Build bench test setups, collect and analyze characterization data, and report what the data shows. Drive decisions from measured data and physics. * **Manufacturing \& Supplier Support:** Support production test fixtures, design for testability, and electrical builds with our contract manufacturer and suppliers. Help triage and root\-cause issues found in manufacturing and in the field. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner with Mechanical, Controls, Software, and Operations on motor selection, drivers, sensors, and system bring\-up, and communicate what you find clearly to partners outside your discipline. * **Documentation:** Produce the documentation others need to use your work: schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, test plans, and test reports. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * **Education \& Experience:** BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, with 0–3 years of professional experience. Internships, co\-ops, research, competition teams, or substantial personal projects count. * **Circuit Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design, power electronics basics, and schematic capture in a professional tool such as Altium. You can read a datasheet and justify a component choice with numbers. * **Embedded Firmware \& Python:** Working proficiency in C or C\+\+ on microcontrollers, bare\-metal or RTOS, with familiarity across common peripherals and communication protocols, and in Python for test automation and application\-level work. Comfortable with Git and code review. * **Lab Skills:** Hands\-on with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench power supplies, and comfortable soldering and reworking your own boards. * **Debugging Mindset:** You approach a failure with a clear question in mind: what is happening, why, and how would I prove it. You stay with a problem until you find the actual cause rather than a workaround. * **Cross\-Disciplinary Curiosity:** Interest in how electronics, firmware, and mechanics come together in a working machine, and comfort working with engineers outside your discipline. * **Communication:** Clear written and verbal skills. You document what you did and explain what you found so others can act on it. * **Adaptability:** A driven self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot as priorities shift in a fast\-moving startup; willing to take on work outside your core role when required. * **Nice to Have:** Experience with brushless motor control or motor drivers, sensor signal conditioning, PCB layout, or robotics projects. * **Work Onsite:** Ability to work from our NYC office 5 days a week. **What’s In It For You** ------------------------ * Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery * The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living * Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun! * 100% employer\-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents * Flexible time off * Quarterly Wellness Days \- everyone fully unplugs * Generous parental leave * Complimentary OneMedical membership * 401(k) with employer matching * Home office budget * Annual stipend for professional development * Working late? Dinner is on us * Complimentary Aescape recovery sessions for yourself, friends \& family **Compensation**: Base salary range of **$95,000 \- $125,000** annually, plus discretionary annual bonus, plus equity grant commensurate with the role and company stage. Full\-time employees are also eligible for our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and paid parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Aescape is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The salary range listed above is a good\-faith estimate provided in accordance with New York City's pay transparency law. **Begin Your Aescape Career Journey** ------------------------------------- At Aescape, we're on a mission to redefine self\-care for a better world, and we're seeking trailblazers to join us on this journey. We're inspired by individuals who are passionate, driven, and eager to learn. We value diverse perspectives and resourceful, determined individuals who are committed to making a difference. At Aescape, we empower people to reach their full potential, just as our product empowers better living. If you're ready to innovate, create, and make a meaningful impact, we want you on our team. **YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR AESCAPE.**
